Research · the partner experience at the card networks

How the networks' partner experiences work, and where Discover can win

What it is like to be a partner of Visa, Mastercard, American Express and the Discover family at every stage, from evaluating a network to leaving it, for issuers, acquirers, payment facilitators, ATM operators, fintechs, developers and merchants. Each stage ends in the design moves that would give Discover an advantage.

9 stages · 16 ranked design moves · 2,197 sources cited · public sources only · September 25 to 26, 2026

Stages9From evaluating a network to leaving it
Design moves16Ranked by the advantage each would create
Stage moves81The detailed moves behind the ranking
Primary sources62%Share of cited sources read on a primary document

Scope

Public sources only, for every network, Discover included. Tools behind a login are described from public user guides, manuals, documentation, videos and filings, and the report says where nothing public shows them. Documents are used when anyone can open them without a login or paywall, including those marked confidential, and the source register records the marking.

How to read it

The strategy comes first, then one chapter per stage. Each chapter opens with its design moves, then compares how each network works for each partner type. Every sentence stated as fact links to its source in the register.

The design strategy

Across the journey, the card networks run partner experiences through people, gated portals and daily files, and most of what matters sits behind a contract or a login (Visa Core Rules · American Express Global Network · Mastercard Rules · Contact Us · American Express Certification · Get Started).

Most partners never meet the network directly, since sponsor banks, processors and programme managers register them, certify for them, relay change and translate disputes (Visa's Licensing Program · Visa Core Rules · Mastercard Rules · Priority Technology Holdings 10-K · EMV Testing and Certification · Card Network Certifications 2026 · Card Network Mandates · Cards & Payments · Chargebacks).

Money is where partners have least certainty, because invoice lines rarely trace to transactions, downgrades surface after the fact and no partner-facing incentive tracker was found (Market review of card · Decision on requests · Settlement Operations Support Self-Service · Global Clearing Management System · Client Incentive Performance Finance · Manager, Deal Management).

Visa and Mastercard lead on open developer sandboxes, published rulebooks and incentive budgets of 15.75 and 20.5 billion dollars in their 2025 years (Pricing on Visa Developer · Quick Start Guide · Mastercard Rules for Merchants · Visa Core Rules · Visa 10-K 2025 · Mastercard 10-K 2025).

The Discover family already holds pieces of a better experience, such as PULSE's one-page invoice and Debit Dashboard, a live host simulator and a light change load (Discover Debit · Unlock the Value · EMV Testing and Certification · Card Network Certifications 2026 · Card Network Mandates).

The study infers that Discover cannot outbid incumbent incentives, so its opening lies in certainty the incumbents do not give: traceable money, one shared record and plain change (Capital One 10-K 2025 · Decision on requests · Specific Direction 22 · Getting Started with Product · Card Network Certifications 2026).

How the incumbents' partner experiences work

P1The partner meets the network through intermediaries
Observed
Most partners join through a sponsor bank or principal that registers them and carries their liability (Visa's Licensing Program · Visa Core Rules · Mastercard Rules · Priority Technology Holdings 10-K · BSA/AML Examination Manual). Banks and credit unions often evaluate networks through paid negotiators who run incentive bids between Visa and Mastercard (Contract Negotiations · Card Networks). Processors test hosts once per platform, and Marqeta certifies each network release for all its clients and tells them when nothing is needed (EMV Testing and Certification · Card Network Certifications 2026). Small issuers, fintechs and most merchants never touch a network dispute tool, because processors translate network stages into their own states and codes (Card Dispute Consultant · Chargebacks · Disputes · Worldpay Disputes API). Amex arms OptBlue sales agents with an objection guide and comparative spend data, so its case reaches merchants through the channel (OptBlue Sales Agent · Welcome to OptBlue). The study infers that the intermediary is the customer the experience must serve first, with the end partner given a view of its own record (Quick Start Guide · How to Manage · Cards & Payments).
Stages
Evaluate · Join and contract · Onboard and certify · Build and integrate · Run: disputes and fraud · Run: change, support and incidents
P2The real tools sit behind login and people
Observed
The ISO 8583 host specifications that acquirers build to are marked confidential at all four networks (Visa Core Rules · Mastercard Rules · API Basics · American Express Certification · Get Started · EASI Portal Registration Guide). Host certification is led by a network representative everywhere, and token services are the least self-serve surface (EMV Testing and Certification · Visa Token Service · Getting Started · Amex Token Service Guide). Visa and Mastercard hand user set-up to administrators inside the partner, and Mastercard names them on a form sent by email (Mastercard Connect Overview 2022 · Mastercard Connect Access 1145b · Visa Access Support). Visa keeps its dispute screens restricted, so what partners see is inferred from processor portals that mirror them (Visa Resolve Online · iQ Reporting and Analytics · iQ Reporting and Analytics). After go-live, growth runs through a named relationship owner at every network, and self-service ordering exists only in patches such as Mastercard's Connect Store (Director Client Success · Visa Ready Program · Associate Analyst, Account Management · American Express Certification · Contact Us · Mastercard Connect Overview 2022 · Partners).
Stages
Evaluate · Onboard and certify · Build and integrate · Run: disputes and fraud · Growing the relationship, and leaving it
P3Change arrives second hand
Observed
Every network pushes change through gated bulletins on a fixed calendar (Visa Core Rules · Chargebacks Made Simple Guide · AN 6977 Revised Standards). Visa says its Business News articles are not public, and Mastercard bulletins reach only members through Mastercard Connect (Visa Merchant Business News · Mastercard GMAP Explained). Issuer processors republish each mandate with an impact note, and one credit union CUSO asks clients to forward network mail (Card Network Mandates · Card Network Certifications 2026 · Cards & Payments). Some Visa bulletins omitted the billing event, so new fees appeared first on invoices (Market review of card · Stakeholder submissions to MR22/1.6). UK acquirers holding over 65 percent of the market struggle to get timely answers, and a US payfac filing calls network compliance timelines highly compressed (MR22/1.10 Market review · Priority Technology Holdings 10-K). In certification, retest triggers when anything in the chain changes are a named friction (Options for Reducing Level · Visa Smart Debit/Credit · EMV Testing and Certification).
Stages
Onboard and certify · Run: money · Run: change, support and incidents
P4Money arrives as files the partner must reconcile
Observed
On every network studied, money runs on daily files and reports that the partner reconciles itself, with billing in a separate stream (Settlement Operations Support Self-Service · Settlement and Reconciliation · Global Clearing Management System · Business and Operational Policies · Mastercard Pricing & Fees · Best Practices). Portal bulletin codes do not match invoice codes, and Visa and Mastercard told the UK regulator they could not supply fee logic within a year (Market review of card · Decision on requests · PS26/1 Market review). Interchange downgrades are found after the fact in processor reports, and Mastercard's parameter file lists rate designators without the rates (Settlement Operations Support Self-Service · Global Clearing Management System). The UK regulator found issuers generally cope with fee information while acquirers do not, and large UK acquirers buy scheme services to understand their own fees (Market review of card · MR22/1.10 Market review · MR22/1.6 consultation responses). Stripe and Lithic turn raw network files into settlement records with states, and vendors sell invoice analysis to acquirers and issuers (Issuing settlements · Settlement API · Solutions for Merchant Acquirers · Network Fee Tracking). American Express is the clearest counterexample, publishing settlement timing, fee amounts and the net payment arithmetic (Business and Operational Policies · Finance::AMEX::Transaction::GRRCN::Summary · Finance::AMEX::Transaction::GRRCN::TxnPricing).
Stages
Run: money · Growing the relationship, and leaving it
P5Price and terms stay hidden until a negotiation
Observed
No network publishes a self-serve way for a prospective issuer, acquirer or ATM operator to see its price (Visa Core Rules · American Express Global Network · U.S. Acquirer Interchange Pricing · Mastercard Rules · Community Issuers contact form · Contact Us · Contact Us · Connect With Us). Participants told the RBA that confidentiality terms stop them comparing network prices or understanding their own bills (Scheme Fees · Scheme Fees, Conclusions Paper). Joining fees are mostly unpublished, with exceptions such as no-fee OptBlue payment facilitator and AMEX Enabled registration (Third Party Agent Registration · Mastercard Rules · Payments Facilitator Acceptance · AMEX Enabled Frequently Asked). Incentives are the main commercial lever, and Mastercard contracts carry clawbacks while DOJ alleges Visa can claw back incentives as early termination fees (Visa 10-K 2025 · Mastercard 10-K 2025 · Manager, Deal Management · United States v. Visa). Interac and eftpos publish network fees, and the RBA is forcing publication in Australia (Understanding Fees · Interchange fees · Merchant Card Payment Costs).
Stages
Evaluate · Join and contract · Growing the relationship, and leaving it
P6No single record says where a partner stands
Observed
Identifiers arrive through several tools and deadlines, such as Visa's temporary UVID followed by a Business ID (Visa's Licensing Program · Business and Operational Policies · Mastercard Rules). At the partner, joining work is case work that sponsor staff track in Excel (Payment Network Compliance Analyst). Each network closes certification with a different artefact, from Mastercard's TAN letter to Amex's summary with live terminal parameters (EMV Testing and Certification). The clearest progress tracking in public view belongs to Amex's AMEX Enabled dashboard and UnionPay's project record (AMEX Enabled Overview · Getting Started with Product). Visa and Mastercard rules never use the word pilot, and their go-live is a string of approvals with no single live moment (Visa Core Rules · Mastercard Rules). Amex is the only network whose public rules define an issuer launch gate, ending in a written go-ahead (American Express Global Network).
Stages
Join and contract · Onboard and certify · Launch
P7Disputes share one skeleton and hide the ratio
Observed
Every network runs the same dispute skeleton from claim to ruling, wrapped in its own tool, vocabulary and clock (Visa Core Rules · Chargeback Guide Merchant Edition · Business and Operational Policies · Dispute Ticket Retrieval Request · Best Practices for Disputes). The contest has moved before the chargeback, with Visa's Rapid Dispute Resolution switched on for issuers by default (Rapid Dispute Resolution · Compelling Evidence 3.0 · Mastercard Rules). Monitoring counts fraud and disputes together at portfolio level, and merchants and payfacs cannot see the items behind their own ratio (Visa Acquirer Monitoring Program · New VAMP for 2025 · Dispute and fraud card). Amex's merchant screen sorts cases by whose move it is and shows the days left to respond (How to use · Managing a Dispute Case).
Stages
Run: disputes and fraud
P8Commitments are rare and cover the network's own steps
Observed
Published turnarounds are few, such as EASI review in two business days and PULSE credentials in five (EASI Portal Registration Guide · Log In / Register · Knowledge Base · MDES Token Connect · Mastercom Onboarding Checklist). Amex writes review windows into its launch policies, and Mastercard pairs its service levels with escalation channels (American Express Global Network · Mastercom, Mastercard Developers). Visa says onboarding time is the first question clients ask (Visa Developer Onboarding). No public status page for core authorisation and settlement was found for any of the four networks (API Status · Visa Acceptance Solutions Status · Mastercard Status · Insights). An independent review found Visa's 2018 outage communications were not timely, regular or actionable (Specific Direction 9).

Where the Discover family stands

The family leads for small issuers, where PULSE offers a scheduled portfolio analysis backed by an ABA due diligence report and a one-page all-in invoice (Discover Debit · Discover Debit). It also leads with the PULSE Debit Dashboard, open to every PULSE issuer with interchange by category and a peer comparison (Unlock the Value). It is level or ahead in certification, with self-certification routes, a self-registering acquirer portal with a stated review time and a simulator that shows results live (EMV Testing and Certification · Discover EASI Portal Login · EASI Portal Registration Guide). It is behind at the door, where developers need an invitation, fintechs find no named provider and every partner type is routed to a contact form (FAQ · Developers Guide, section · Fintech Partnerships · Get card transaction · Contact Us · How We Partner). It is behind in running the relationship, with a fully gated Disputes Portal, private PULSE rules and bulletins, and US acquirer rates behind a code (Discover Global Network · Best Practices for Disputes · Client Support · U.S. Acquirer Interchange Pricing). The Fed found Discover misclassified cards for sixteen years without telling merchants, and its owner's move of about 25 million debit cards put visible costs on merchants (Order to Cease · Capital One 10-K 2025 · After Moving Debit Cards · Changes following Capital One's).

Design principles for advantage

1Make every sum traceable
Why
Tie each fee, interchange line and settlement total to its transactions, card class and rule, because that is where acquirers struggle most (Market review of card · MR22/1.10 Market review). Visa and Mastercard told the UK regulator they could not supply this within a year. The study infers that a free trace is a lead they cannot close quickly (Decision on requests · PS26/1 Market review). Amex already publishes the net payment arithmetic, which shows the promise can be kept (Finance::AMEX::Transaction::GRRCN::Summary · Finance::AMEX::Transaction::GRRCN::TxnPricing).
Stages
Run: money · Growing the relationship, and leaving it
2Serve the intermediary, show the end partner
Why
Design first for the sponsor, processor or programme manager that acts for many clients, because that is how most partners reach a network (Priority Technology Holdings 10-K · EMV Testing and Certification · Card Dispute Consultant). Give each end partner a read-only view of its own record, since small issuers and fintechs learn dispute outcomes late or never (Disputes · Supervisor, Dispute Operations (Velera)).
Stages
Join and contract · Onboard and certify · Build and integrate · Run: disputes and fraud · Run: change, support and incidents
3Let partners see and try before they sign
Why
Open specifications, sandbox keys, provider lists and joining steps to strangers, as Visa and Mastercard do for developers and fintechs (Pricing on Visa Developer · Quick Start Guide · Find a Partner · Licensing Program). The study infers that Discover's invitation-only Developer Center and contact-form doors remove it from shortlists before any conversation (FAQ · Contact Us · Choose Your Own (Card).
Stages
Evaluate · Join and contract · Build and integrate
4Prove value on the partner's own numbers
Why
Lead with money, reach and yield shown on the partner's own data, and keep process in the background (Unlock the Value · Welcome to OptBlue · Visa Direct Revenue Calculator). PULSE's account executive says most issuers do not know their interchange, and Discover's merchant pages give no spend figure (Unlock the Value · Accept Our Network).
Stages
Evaluate · Launch · Growing the relationship, and leaving it
5Keep one record from joining to exit
Why
Hold identifiers, owners, certification letters, commitments and orders in one record that partner and network staff both read (Getting Started with Product · AMEX Enabled Overview · Business and Operational Policies). The earlier study classes one sign-in as parity, so the advantage lies in what the record holds (Visa Partner Support · Company Verification · GitHub issues · Stack Overflow).
Stages
Join and contract · Onboard and certify · Launch · Growing the relationship, and leaving it
6Tell each partner what a change means for it
Why
Type each change, state its effective date and give each partner a verdict, including when its processor has handled it or nothing is needed (Business and Operational Policies · Card Network Mandates · Card Network Certifications 2026). Discover's light change load is a real benefit that only processors voice today (Card Network Certifications 2026 · Card Network Mandates).
Stages
Run: money · Run: change, support and incidents
7Show whose move it is and what the network promises
Why
Every case, step and order should show its owner and next action, as Amex does with days left on each dispute (Managing a Dispute Case · Disputes (PULSE)). Commit to service levels on the network's own steps, each with an escalation route (Mastercom Onboarding Checklist · Mastercom, Mastercard Developers · Visa Developer Onboarding).
Stages
Join and contract · Onboard and certify · Launch · Run: disputes and fraud · Run: change, support and incidents
8Publish the rules, including how to leave
Why
Publish dispute rules, monitoring lines, money rules and exit terms with dated changes, as Mastercard and Amex do for parts of theirs (Mastercard Rules for Merchants · Business and Operational Policies · Mastercard Rules). Discover and PULSE keep dispute rules gated, and Discover publishes no exit terms while its owner competes with partner issuers (Best Practices for Disputes · Discover Chargeback Guide · Discover 10-K 2024 · Capital One 10-K 2025).
Stages
Run: money · Run: disputes and fraud · Growing the relationship, and leaving it

The design moves, ranked

Ranked by the advantage each would create for partners and for Discover, weighed against the strength of the evidence. Each links to the stage where the detail sits.

M1Every fee line traces to its transactions and card classStrong evidence
The move
Give each invoice and interchange line a stable billing identifier, its trigger rule and a link to its transactions. Show each transaction's card class, the programme it was priced at and any downgrade reason. Correct errors for every affected partner beside the original line.
Why it wins
Visa and Mastercard each told the UK regulator they could not supply fee logic within a year (Decision on requests · PS26/1 Market review). Portal codes that differ from invoice codes are a documented acquirer complaint, and UK acquirers buy scheme services to understand their own fees (Market review of card · MR22/1.10 Market review · MR22/1.6 consultation responses). UK rules require a unique billing identifier and fee logic from July 2027, and the study infers that doing this worldwide would put Discover ahead of that floor (Specific Direction 22). The Fed found Discover charged a commercial rate for sixteen years without telling merchants, and the Fed's order now requires classification controls for each acquirer and merchant (Order to Cease).
For
Acquirers and processors, Payment facilitators and ISOs, Issuers, Merchants where they touch the network directly
Surfaces
Partner portal, Value proposition and sales, Developer experience
Stage
Run: money
M2Settlement totals that tie to the funds movedStrong evidence
The move
State the settlement arithmetic on screen and show each day's tie-out between report totals and funds moved. Show each settlement day and file as pending or complete, with a notice when a network file is late. Offer the same data as files and an API, and keep PULSE's one-page invoice as the default view.
Why it wins
Issuers rebuild Mastercard fund reconciliation from fragments, while Amex, Mastercard Send and Discover's own old report show a tie-out can be promised (How issuer banks can · Reconciliation Reports · Finance::AMEX::Transaction::GRRCN::Summary · Daily Activity Report Sample). Late network files are the main cause of processor settlement delays, and Stripe and Lithic already treat completeness as a state (Settlement API · Issuing settlements · Settlement API). Mastercard's public catalogue has no settlement or billing API, and programme managers each build their own wrapper (Mastercard Developers llms.txt catalogue · Settlement API · Settlement and Reconciliation). Community banks and credit unions complain of long, error-prone bills, and PULSE already sells a one-page invoice with single-point settlement (Comment on Docket OCC-2025-0537 · Request for Information Regarding · Discover Debit · PULSE Gateway Services).
For
Issuers, Fintechs and programme managers, Acquirers and processors, ATM operators, Developers
Surfaces
Partner portal, Developer experience, Network operations tools, Value proposition and sales
Stage
Run: money
M3Build for the processor as the customerStrong evidence
The move
Let a processor, CUSO or programme manager act for many clients in one place. It creates projects, passes on its certification, works dispute queues and subscribes clients to notices. Each client sees its own record read-only.
Why it wins
Host testing runs once per platform, and Marqeta certifies each network release for all its clients (EMV Testing and Certification · Card Network Certifications 2026). Visa registers an agent separately per acquirer, while Mastercard's Modular M-TIP and Product Express show certification reuse works (Visa Core Rules · EMV Testing and Certification · Mastercard Product Express). Among the portals read, Mastercard offers an on-behalf-of-a-client flag and a portal API (Quick Start Guide · Platform Overview). Small issuers and fintechs reach networks through processors and learn dispute outcomes late or never (Card Dispute Consultant · Disputes · Supervisor, Dispute Operations (Velera)).
For
Acquirers and processors, Processors, gateways and platforms certifying for many clients, Community banks and credit unions, Fintechs and programme managers, Payment facilitators and ISOs
Surfaces
Partner portal, Developer experience, Network operations tools
Stage
Build and integrate
M4Publish the platforms that carry DiscoverStrong evidence
The move
Publish the processors, sponsor banks and programme managers that carry the network, by product and country. Start the fintech path inside one of them, and show which of its clients inherit that platform's certification.
Why it wins
Visa and Mastercard court fintechs through enabler directories, and Visa's can be filtered before any contact (Find a Partner · Mastercard Engage Partner Directory · Visa Partner). Four of six issuing platforms checked document no Discover issuing, and a fintech guide drops Discover from the network choice (Customize your card program · Adyen Issuing · Get card transaction · Highnote Documentation index · Choose Your Own (Card). Discover's fintech page names no processor, sponsor bank or programme manager, although Marqeta states it is certified on Discover's current release (Fintech Partnerships · Card Network Certifications 2026). Amex lets fintechs issue on its network through the issuing platforms they already use (Lithic Expands Platform).
For
Fintechs and programme managers, Developers
Surfaces
Value proposition and sales, Developer experience, Partner portal
Stage
Evaluate
M5Free early resolution and a published dispute lineStrong evidence
The move
Route each new claim through a merchant resolution step at no per-alert fee, and count resolved claims as prevented. Publish Discover's dispute and fraud thresholds and dated dispute rules. Give acquirers a live ratio per merchant and sub-merchant with every counted item listed.
Why it wins
Visa switched Rapid Dispute Resolution on for issuers by default and excludes pre-dispute resolutions from monitoring (Rapid Dispute Resolution · Visa Acquirer Monitoring Program). Merchants pay per alert elsewhere, and Mastercard's acquirer collaboration route is reported to be ending (Chargeback Alerts Compared · Chargeback alert pricing hides · Mastercard Acquirer Collaboration Ends). Merchants cannot see the items behind Visa's monitoring ratio, and the data arrives a month late (New VAMP for 2025 · Dispute and fraud card). Discover's dispute line surfaces only through vendors, and a practitioner guide finds no Discover equivalent of the main pre-dispute tools (Discover Chargeback Guide · Exploring the Chargeback Threshold · Discover Chargebacks). Discover's Fraud Alerts already has a free standard tier to build from (Fraud Management Tools).
For
Acquirers and processors, Payment facilitators and ISOs, Merchants where they touch the network directly, Issuers: large banks
Surfaces
Partner portal, Value proposition and sales, Network operations tools
Stage
Run: disputes and fraud
M6Tell each partner what a change means for itStrong evidence
The move
Publish every rule, fee and specification change as one ledger item typed action, legal or information, with audience, region and effective date. Show each partner a verdict: act, your processor has handled it, or nothing needed. Commit to a minimum notice period, name the billing line a fee change will use and attach a request-more-time action.
Why it wins
Amex types changes and Mastercard headers carry action indicators, yet no network tells a partner whether its processor has already absorbed the work (Business and Operational Policies · AN 6977 Revised Standards · Card Network Mandates · Card Network Certifications 2026). Visa and Mastercard bulletins are private, and a CUSO relies on clients forwarding network mail (Visa Merchant Business News · Mastercard GMAP Explained · Cards & Payments). Some Visa bulletins omitted the billing event, so fees first appeared on invoices (Market review of card · Stakeholder submissions to MR22/1.6). The UK now requires six months' notice of fee changes and Canada 120 days, so a worldwide commitment turns regulation into a promise (PS26/1 Market review · Code of Conduct). Processors report that recent Discover and PULSE releases needed nothing from clients, a benefit the network does not yet state itself (Card Network Certifications 2026 · Card Network Mandates).
For
Issuers, Acquirers and processors, Payment facilitators and ISOs, ATM operators, Fintechs and programme managers, Developers, Merchants where they touch the network directly

M7A sandbox key on the first visitStrong evidence
The move
Let a signed-up developer create a project, get sandbox credentials and published test cards, and call the existing APIs with no representative. Publish specifications, a pricing model page and markdown twins for coding assistants before any contact. Let developers reissue their own keys.
Why it wins
Visa and Mastercard let any registered developer create a project and call a sandbox the same day (Pricing on Visa Developer · Quick Start Guide). Discover's Developer Center admits developers only by a representative's invitation, the largest build gap the study found (FAQ · Developers Guide, section). Discover already publishes twelve readable OpenAPI specifications, yet test cases arrive only during certification boarding (Issuer Card Account Services · Going Live with Discover). Mastercard and Visa publish documentation for coding assistants, while Discover's portals return 404 or a bare title to a fetching tool (Working with llms.txt · Mastercard Developers Agent Toolkit · Documentation MCP Server · VisaAcceptance Developer Center · 404 Not Found · Discover Stored Token Services). This reaches parity with Visa and Mastercard and moves ahead of the American Express key review (American Express Developers · Pricing on Visa Developer · Quick Start Guide).
For
Developers, Fintechs and programme managers, Payment facilitators and ISOs, Merchants
Surfaces
Developer experience, Partner portal
Stage
Build and integrate
M8Partner economics in one shared viewModerate evidence
The move
Extend the PULSE Debit Dashboard across the family, with each partner's own economics and a peer comparison. Show each incentive commitment, its measure, the partner's standing and payment status, including any clawback trigger. Build the business review and renewal from this shared data.
Why it wins
PULSE already gives every issuer its economics with a peer comparison, and its account executive says most issuers do not know their interchange (Unlock the Value). Visa and Mastercard track incentives in internal files, billing systems and quarterly reviews, and the study found no partner-facing tracker (Client Incentive Performance Finance · Financial Analyst · Manager, Deal Management). Both networks estimate earned incentives partly from forecasts and client-reported data, which the study infers a partner cannot check from outside (Visa 10-K 2025 · Mastercard 10-K 2025). Consultants win renewals by negotiating, and regulators are forcing fee clarity (Payments Card Networks Advisors · Scheme Fees · Code of Conduct).

M9Every dispute case shows whose move it isStrong evidence
The move
Make each case status a next action with an owner and a day count drawn from the condition's own time limit. Let one issuer action file the fraud report and open the dispute. Show Reg E deadlines beside network deadlines, and publish the same states through the API.
Why it wins
Amex shows merchants the days left to respond, and a PULSE processor wrapper shows next actor and days left (Managing a Dispute Case · Disputes (PULSE)). Each fintech processor invents its own dispute states, so one network vocabulary would travel across all of them (Chargebacks · Disputes · Managing Visa Disputes). Visa and Mastercard require the fraud report before the dispute, and Mastercard already files it from inside the claim (Visa Core Rules · Chargeback Guide Merchant Edition · Mastercom Use Cases). The only public tool found that warns on the Reg E deadline is a processor portal (About Regulation E · § 1005.11 Procedures). Discover's fraud reporting sits in a separate portal enrolled by signed forms, and its public merchant help describes a legacy interface (Confirmed Fraud Portal Access · Account Incident Manager (AIM) · Dispute System Interface).
For
Issuers: large banks, Issuers: community banks and credit unions, Fintechs and programme managers, Acquirers and processors, Merchants where they touch the network directly
Surfaces
Partner portal, Developer experience, Value proposition and sales
Stage
Run: disputes and fraud
M10A conversion kit for issuers moving inStrong evidence
The move
Package conversion as a tracked plan covering pilot waves, the overlap window, account updater coverage, merchant and payroll notices, PIN changes and acceptance where cardholders travel. Show which major acquirers have loaded the new ranges before cards ship.
Why it wins
Capital One's move of about 25 million debit cards is the one large conversion with public detail, and it began with pilot populations in June 2025 (After Moving Debit Cards · Capital One (COF) Q2 · Capital One 10-K 2025). Its friction landed on cardholders and merchants through new numbers, a 130-day overlap, instant-transfer gaps and travel acceptance warnings (New debit card, same · Changes following Capital One's · Changes to instant transfers · Traveling with debit card). Costco's single-day cutover produced 1.5 million service calls, while Walmart's phased move let old cards work until new ones were active (Costco's transition to Visa). Visa Account Updater carries other networks' portfolios into Visa and, outside Latin America, carries none out (Visa Account Updater (VAU)). Every network sets a table-load deadline, and no public source shows a network telling issuers whether acceptance is ready (Visa Core Rules · 8-Digit BIN Migration Toolkit · Global Payment Network IIN).

The move
Turn the Debit Advantage Analysis into a model a prospect runs on its own mix, with assumptions visible. Show a standard acquirer and ATM schedule before sign-up, with incentives on a separate line. Publishing US rates is a business decision.
Why it wins
No network publishes a self-serve way for a prospective issuer, acquirer or ATM operator to see its price (Visa Core Rules · American Express Global Network · U.S. Acquirer Interchange Pricing · Mastercard Rules). Visa publishes exempt debit rates and runs a public calculator, while every number a small issuer needs from PULSE arrives after a call (Visa USA Interchange Reimbursement · Visa Direct Revenue Calculator · Discover Debit). Discover already publishes its Canadian standard acquirer schedule, and Interac and eftpos publish network fees (Standard Acquirer Rates · Understanding Fees · Interchange fees). Banks already buy due diligence from the ABA and advisers, and the study infers that a network supplying it first sets the terms of comparison (Discover Debit · Contract Negotiations · The Rising Value).

M12One front door and a join map with network commitmentsStrong evidence
The move
Replace scattered forms and mailboxes with one intake that routes by partner type. Each path states who signs, whether a sponsor is needed, the documents asked for, the identifiers issued and who owns the next step. Show the network's committed response time on its own steps, with an escalation route.
Why it wins
Only Visa publishes the steps for a direct licence, and Discover routes every partner type to a contact form (Visa's Licensing Program · Contact Us · How We Partner). Most partners join through a sponsor, and sponsor staff track registrations as case work in Excel (Priority Technology Holdings 10-K · Payment Network Compliance Analyst). Published service levels for joining are rare, with PULSE's five-day credential promise and Elo's reconsideration window as exceptions (Log In / Register · Regulamento dos Arranjos · Mastercom Onboarding Checklist). Visa says timing is the first question clients ask, and Mastercard pairs its service levels with escalation channels (Visa Developer Onboarding · Mastercom, Mastercard Developers).
For
Issuers: large banks (direct licensees), Issuers: community banks and credit unions (sponsored or associate), Acquirers and processors, Payment facilitators and ISOs, ATM operators (independent deployers and bank fleets), Fintechs and programme managers, Developers and technology service providers
Surfaces
Value proposition and sales, Partner portal, Developer experience, Network operations tools
Stage
Join and contract
M13One certification record with live resultsStrong evidence
The move
Keep one project record per partner that partner and network staff both read, with an owner, state and sign-off on each step. Generate cases from the partner's stated configuration and show simulator results live. Store each certification letter with its tested configuration, and check before a change whether it needs retesting.
Why it wins
Amex's AMEX Enabled dashboard and UnionPay's project record show certification progress, while public sources show Visa and Mastercard tracking only access orders and admin tasks (AMEX Enabled Overview · Getting Started with Product · Mastercard Connect Overview 2022). Discover's designated simulator already lets acquirers test at any time and see results immediately (EMV Testing and Certification). Mastercard's MDES asks for an Excel file by email, and Discover's certification forms come through an implementation manager (Test Result Submission · EMV Testing and Certification). A vendor reports that failed certification windows are costly elsewhere, and retest triggers are a named friction (ISO 8583 Certification Testing · Options for Reducing Level · EMV Testing and Certification). The earlier study classes a shared record as parity, so the study infers the advantage rests on the live results and portable letters it holds (Getting Started with Product · Visa Partner Support · Company Verification).
For
Acquirers and acquirer processors, Processors, gateways and platforms certifying for many clients, Issuers: large banks, Payment facilitators and ISOs, Merchants connecting directly
Surfaces
Partner portal, Developer experience, Network operations tools
Stage
Onboard and certify
M14Status and incident reports for the core networkStrong evidence
The move
Run a partner status view for authorisation, settlement, portals and APIs, with subscriptions. Declare an update rhythm during incidents and publish a post-incident report every partner can read. Publish one support map by partner type and problem, with hours and response commitments.
Why it wins
No public status page for core authorisation and settlement was found for any of the four networks (API Status · Visa Acceptance Solutions Status · Mastercard Status · Insights). An independent review found Visa's 2018 outage communications were not timely, regular or actionable, and the UK regulator now requires annual testing with participants (Specific Direction 9). Mastercard shares post-incident reports only through account managers (Director, Technology Account Management). Discover and PULSE spread support across many mailboxes and business-hours desks, and no Discover status page was found (Contact Us · Connect With Us · Discover Partner Product Portal · Discover Developer Center, walked).
For
Issuers, Acquirers and processors, Payment facilitators and ISOs, ATM operators, Fintechs and programme managers, Developers
Surfaces
Developer experience, Partner portal, Value proposition and sales, Network operations tools
Stage
Run: change, support and incidents
M15A written go-ahead and a shared launch viewStrong evidence
The move
Make go-live a single network-issued notice listing what was certified, the sample card or test result approved, the effective date and the first live transactions seen. After go-live, open a shared view of approvals, declines by reason and disputes with the named implementation lead.
Why it wins
Visa and Mastercard rules define no pilot and no single live moment (Visa Core Rules · Mastercard Rules). Amex issues a written go-ahead before launch, and Mastercard Send asks partners to find their first transactions in reconciliation reports (American Express Global Network · Mastercard Send Onboarding Checklist). Discover already promises launch support and monitoring and names an implementation project manager for Discover Debit (Going Live with Discover · Discover Debit). Visa's rule for day-31 new-merchant exception reports carries an end date of 17 April 2026, so a shared early view would fill a gap (Visa Core Rules).
For
Issuers: large banks, Issuers: community banks and credit unions, Fintechs and programme managers, Acquirers and processors, Developers
Surfaces
Partner portal, Value proposition and sales, Network operations tools
Stage
Launch
M16Arm the channel with merchant valueModerate evidence
The move
Give acquirers, ISOs and ATM processors a seller kit with merchant-level value evidence, dated peer proof and objection answers. Put mark rules, bulk signage ordering and post-launch deadlines in the same kit.
Why it wins
Amex gives OptBlue sales agents an objection guide and comparative spend data (OptBlue Sales Agent · Welcome to OptBlue). Discover's pages give merchants reach claims and no figure for what network cardholders spend with them (Accept Our Network · Discover Global Network sitemap). ISOs and payfacs can register on EASI for technical material, yet get no sales kit (EASI Portal registration · Discover Global Network sitemap). PULSE's exclusive card access is its strongest ATM pitch, yet operators rarely see it because processors decide (ATM Acquirers · ATM Processing). Amex gives agents bulk signage ordering, while Discover's signage site needs a separate login (American Express Signage Bulk · Discover Signage Site).
For
Payment facilitators and ISOs, Acquirers and processors, ATM operators, Merchants (direct touchpoints)
Surfaces
Value proposition and sales, Partner portal, Network operations tools
Stage
Evaluate

Evaluate

No network publishes a self-serve way for a prospective issuer, acquirer or ATM operator to see its price. Every route ends in a form, a mailbox or an account executive (Visa Core Rules · American Express Global Network · U.S. Acquirer Interchange Pricing · Mastercard Rules · Community Issuers contact form · Contact Us · Contact Us · Connect With Us). Of the four, only Visa was found to publish licensing steps, tools and review criteria for a new issuer or acquirer before any contact (Licensing Program). Banks and credit unions often evaluate networks through paid negotiators who run bids between Visa and Mastercard for incentives (Contract Negotiations · Card Networks · The Rising Value · Pay Network). The only neutral cross-network comparison found is the Fed's debit interchange table, and the Fed warns it does not show what any issuer would earn (Average Debit Card Interchange · Federal Reserve issues). Participants told the RBA that confidentiality terms stop them comparing network prices or understanding their own bills (Scheme Fees · Scheme Fees, Conclusions Paper). Discover's strongest evaluation assets sit with PULSE: a named team, a portfolio review, switcher case studies and an ABA endorsement with a due diligence report (Discover Debit · Discover Debit gives you · Discover Debit). For fintechs, Visa and Mastercard run named programmes with directories of enablers, while Discover's fintech page names no processor, sponsor bank or programme manager (Visa Partner · Mastercard Engage · Mastercard Engage Partner Directory · Find a Partner · Fintech Partnerships). Four of six issuing platforms checked document no Discover issuing, and a fintech guide drops Discover and Amex from the network choice altogether (Customize your card program · Adyen Issuing · Get card transaction · Highnote Documentation index · Choose Your Own (Card). Developers can judge Mastercard and Visa from open documentation and a free sandbox, while Discover's Developer Center admits developers only by invitation (Working with llms.txt · Quick Start Guide · Pricing on Visa Developer · Visa Developer Onboarding · FAQs · FAQ). Selling is often done by third parties the networks arm: Amex gives OptBlue sales agents an objection guide and comparative spend data (OptBlue Sales Agent · Welcome to OptBlue · Visa 2025 Investor Day · Mastercard Investment Community Meeting). Evaluation pages go stale: Visa's Fast Track cites a 2022 fact sheet and Amex's issuer page a 2022 ranking (Fintech Fast Track · Issuers).

Design moves at this stage

1.1One front door that names the next stepStrong evidence
The move
Replace scattered forms and mailboxes with one intake that routes by partner type, states the next step, who owns it and the committed reply time.
Why it wins
Rivals end in newsletter forms, mailboxes or representatives. A clear first step with a committed response time would stand out. (Community Issuers contact form · Contact Us · Licensing Program · Contact Us · Client Support)
For
Issuers: large banks, Issuers: community banks and credit unions, Acquirers and processors, Payment facilitators and ISOs, ATM operators, Fintechs and programme managers
1.2A provider shelf for fintechsStrong evidence
The move
Publish the processors, sponsor banks and programme managers that carry the network, by product and country, and start the fintech path inside one of them.
Why it wins
Visa and Mastercard win fintechs through enabler directories. Discover names none, so fintechs never see it as an option. (Find a Partner · Mastercard Engage Partner Directory · Choose Your Own (Card · Fintech Partnerships · Get card transaction · Networks · Card Network Certifications 2026)
For
Fintechs and programme managers
1.3Open evaluation for developersStrong evidence
The move
Make specifications, sandbox keys and a pricing model page available before any representative contact, with markdown twins for assistants.
Why it wins
Mastercard and Visa already allow this, so Discover's invite-only door removes it from developer shortlists. (Working with llms.txt · Quick Start Guide · Pricing on Visa Developer · Visa Developer Onboarding · FAQs · 404 Not Found)
For
Developers
1.4An evaluation pack per partner typeModerate evidence
The move
Give each prospect a downloadable pack: participation model, fee structure lines, service levels the network commits to, ownership separation terms and endorsements.
Why it wins
Banks already buy due diligence from ABA and advisers. A network that supplies it first shortens their work and sets the terms of comparison. (Discover Debit · Contract Negotiations · The Rising Value · Federal Reserve order 2025-10 · Conditional Approval Letter)
For
Issuers: large banks, Issuers: community banks and credit unions, Acquirers and processors
1.5A self-serve debit yield modelModerate evidence
The move
Turn the Debit Advantage Analysis into a model a prospect runs on its own mix, showing exempt yield after routing with its assumptions visible.
Why it wins
Visa publishes exempt rates and runs a public calculator. Discover hides yield behind a call, and the Fed table cannot answer an issuer's own case. (Visa USA Interchange Reimbursement · Discover Debit · Visa Direct Revenue Calculator · Average Debit Card Interchange · Scheme Fees)
For
Issuers: community banks and credit unions, Fintechs and programme managers
1.6Arm the channel that sellsModerate evidence
The move
Give acquirers, ISOs and ATM processors a seller kit with merchant-level value evidence and objection answers, modelled on the OptBlue hub pattern.
Why it wins
Merchants ask what volume a network brings. Amex answers through sellers, while Discover's pages give no spend figure. (OptBlue Sales Agent · Welcome to OptBlue · ATM Processing · Accept Our Network · Why the Capital One/Discover)
For
Payment facilitators and ISOs, Acquirers and processors, ATM operators, Merchants (direct touchpoints)
1.7Price visible to a strangerModerate evidence
The move
Show a standard acquirer schedule and fee structure before sign-up, as Discover already does in Canada, with incentives on a separate line.
Why it wins
No major US network publishes the network fees a prospect would pay. Interac and eftpos do, and the RBA is forcing publication in Australia. (U.S. Acquirer Interchange Pricing · Standard Acquirer Rates · Code of Conduct · Understanding Fees · Interchange fees · Merchant Card Payment Costs)
For
Acquirers and processors, ATM operators, Issuers: community banks and credit unions
1.8Dated proof from peersModerate evidence
The move
Carry case studies and client survey quotes by partner type, each dated and sourced, and keep every headline figure current.
Why it wins
Visa and PULSE use peer case studies, while Visa and Amex pages show figures years old. Fresh proof reads as care. (Turning insights into action · Discover Debit gives you · Why PULSE · Fintech Fast Track · Issuers)
For
Issuers: community banks and credit unions, Issuers: large banks, Fintechs and programme managers

The same guide says winning Visa or Mastercard incentives is hard for startups without deep relationships (Choose Your Own (Card).

What public sources could not show

  1. Mastercard's fintech, issuer and community pages mastercard.com returned Access Denied to every automated fetch on 26 September 2026, and Wayback holds only partial captures. Read the pages in an ordinary browser session, or use Wayback captures from 2025 and 2026.
  2. How large banks run network selections Bids, RFPs and incentive terms are private, and only advisers' marketing describes them. Interview advisers such as Cornerstone or Engage fi, or bank card executives, and read DOJ trial exhibits as they are filed.
  3. Sales decks and first-call materials No network publishes what its account executives present. Conference talk recordings, bank board minutes published by credit unions, and former employees' portfolios.
  4. The content of Visa's CGAP enrolment portal and Portfolio Insights Both sit behind Visa Online. Credit union league webinars and Visa University course outlines.
  5. The ABA due diligence report on Discover Debit and the Debit Advantage Analysis output Both are issued on request to members or prospects. Ask a friendly ABA member bank, or look for bank board packets that attach them.
  6. Discover family events for prospects No partner summit or client conference was found beyond PULSE webinars and a Diners hospitality event. Search Money20/20 and ICBA Capital Summit sponsor lists and PULSE's YouTube channel.
  7. Analyst comparisons of networks Nilson rankings and Datos or Mercator reports are paywalled. Library or subscriber access to Nilson and Datos Insights.
  8. Amex's route for a bank to become a network issuer in the US The site offers only a general contact form and marketing pages. Press releases of recent GNS issuer signings and Amex investor day materials.

Join and contract

Every network gates participation behind a signed agreement, and only Visa publishes the application steps for a direct licence. Mastercard exposes its application form, and American Express and Discover route prospects to a representative or contact form (Visa's Licensing Program · Mastercard Send Registration · American Express Global Network · Contact Us · How We Partner · Business and Operational Policies). Most partners never join directly. ISOs, payment facilitators, ATM deployers, programme managers and small issuers enter through a sponsor bank or principal that registers them and carries their liability (Visa's Licensing Program · Visa Core Rules · Mastercard Rules · Priority Technology Holdings 10-K · BSA/AML Examination Manual · Discover 10-K 2024). Third-party registration is the sponsor's paperwork. The routes are Visa Program Request Management, Mastercard My Company Manager, and OptBlue registration forms emailed to American Express (Visa Core Rules · Mastercard Rules · OptBlue Program Operating Regulations). Due diligence is pushed down the chain. Networks require the sponsor to vet financials, principals and PCI status, and sometimes to visit the site, before registering an agent (Visa Core Rules · OptBlue Program Operating Regulations · Mastercard Rules · Business and Operational Policies). Identifiers arrive as a set at approval. Visa gives a temporary UVID and then a Business ID. American Express assigns participant number ranges, and Mastercard ties each ICA and BIN to a country (Visa's Licensing Program · Business and Operational Policies · Mastercard Rules · Definitions). Joining fees are mostly unpublished. The exceptions are Visa's 2016 agent fees, the American Express active BIN rental fee, no-fee OptBlue and AMEX Enabled registration, and Mastercard's high-risk licence fee (Third Party Agent Registration · Business and Operational Policies · Payments Facilitator Acceptance · AMEX Enabled Frequently Asked · AP/LAC/MEA/US 12568.1 New · Mastercard Rules). Published service levels for joining steps are rare. PULSE promises portal credentials within five business days, and Mastercom and Mastercard Send publish onboarding durations (Log In / Register · Mastercom Onboarding Checklist · Mastercard Send Disbursements Onboarding). Visa's 2016 agent FAQ gave five to seven business days per registration case. The study found no licensing timeline from any of the four networks (Third Party Agent Registration · Visa's Licensing Program · American Express Global Network · How We Partner). At the partner, joining work sits with sponsorship oversight analysts, BIN sponsorship programme managers and network relationship leads. Postings describe it as case work tracked in Excel (Payment Network Compliance Analyst · Payment Network Program Manager · Stripe job posting 8081754). Card numbers trace to the ABA, which registers one IIN per legal entity under ISO/IEC 7812. Networks then license BINs to members, one licensee per BIN (Issuer Identification Numbers · Visa Core Rules · Definitions). The Discover family's public door is a set of contact forms plus EASI self-registration. Diners Club licensing runs through a brand mailbox. PULSE publishes no sponsor or application process (Contact Us · EASI Portal Registration · Diners Club International Issuing · Connect With Us · Discover 10-K 2024).

Design moves at this stage

2.1One join map per partner typeStrong evidence
The move
Open the partner portal with a chooser by partner type. Each path states who signs, whether a sponsor is needed, the documents asked for and the identifiers issued at approval.
Why it wins
Only Visa publishes the steps for a direct licence. American Express hands over rules only after signing, and Discover routes every type to a contact form. (Visa's Licensing Program · American Express Global Network · Contact Us · How We Partner)
For
Issuers: large banks (direct licensees), Issuers: community banks and credit unions (sponsored or associate), Acquirers and processors, Payment facilitators and ISOs, ATM operators (independent deployers and bank fleets), Fintechs and programme managers
2.2A sponsor console for third-party registrationStrong evidence
The move
Give the sponsoring bank one registration record per ISO, payment facilitator or ATM deployer. It holds the diligence checklist, PCI evidence and identifiers, with a visible status up to written approval.
Why it wins
American Express takes these registrations as emailed PDFs and Mastercard takes them in My Company Manager. Sponsor staff track the work in Excel, and Discover publishes no network step. (OptBlue Program Operating Regulations · Mastercard Rules · Payment Network Compliance Analyst · Payment Facilitator Roadmap)
For
Acquirers and processors, Payment facilitators and ISOs, ATM operators (independent deployers and bank fleets)
2.3A welcome record of identifiersModerate evidence
The move
At approval, show one record with the IIN or BIN ranges, participant numbers, settlement parameters and directory entries. Keep the same record live as ranges change.
Why it wins
Rivals issue these through several tools and deadlines. Visa uses a UVID, then a Business ID, then a directory entry due within 10 business days, and American Express assigns ranges during pre-launch support. (Visa's Licensing Program · Visa Core Rules · Business and Operational Policies · Mastercard Rules)
For
Issuers: large banks (direct licensees), Acquirers and processors
2.4Named roles captured once at joiningModerate evidence
The move
Collect the signing authority, senior officer, operations lead and portal administrator in the first form, and reuse them for access, bulletins and escalation.
Why it wins
Visa, Mastercard and American Express each define such roles but collect them in separate directories after launch. EASI already asks for a signing authority at registration. (Visa Core Rules · Mastercard Rules · Business and Operational Policies · EASI Portal Registration)
For
Issuers: large banks (direct licensees), Acquirers and processors, Payment facilitators and ISOs
2.5Service levels on the network's own stepsModerate evidence
The move
State the network's response time for credentials, registration review and reconsideration of a refusal, and show it on each step.
Why it wins
Elo publishes a five-day reconsideration window and PULSE a five-day credential promise. The study found no licensing timeline from Visa, Mastercard or American Express. (Regulamento dos Arranjos · Log In / Register · Third Party Agent Registration · Mastercom Onboarding Checklist)
For
Issuers: large banks (direct licensees), Payment facilitators and ISOs, Developers and technology service providers
2.6Say plainly what joining costsModerate evidence
The move
Publish registration and participation fees, or state that a step carries no fee, on the join map.
Why it wins
Visa's last public agent fee is from 2016, Mastercard's sit behind Connect, and PULSE states participation fees exist without amounts. American Express states that OptBlue payment facilitator and AMEX Enabled registration carry no fee. OptBlue forbids Participants to publish the wholesale fee, yet Fiserv and First Data guides listing every tier sit openly on bank and reseller sites. (Third Party Agent Registration · Mastercard Rules · Discover 10-K 2024 · AMEX Enabled Frequently Asked · Payments Facilitator Acceptance · OptBlue Program Operating Regulations · American Express OptBlue Pricing · American Express OptBlue Pricing)
For
Payment facilitators and ISOs, Developers and technology service providers, Issuers: community banks and credit unions (sponsored or associate)
2.7A public registry with live statusModerate evidence
The move
List registered payment facilitators, ISOs and certified providers with their compliance status, so merchants and sponsors can check them.
Why it wins
Visa's registry shows compliance status and Mastercard lists registered payment facilitators. Discover's Partner Directory lists type-approved products only. (The Visa Global Registry · Third Party Agent Registration · Find a payment facilitator · Partner Directory)
For
Payment facilitators and ISOs, Developers and technology service providers
2.8Carry one application record forwardThin evidence
The move
Pre-fill later onboarding tasks from what the partner gave at registration, so EASI data flows into Going Live stages.
Why it wins
UnionPay's public guide describes pre-filled onboarding tasks. Discover today runs separate doors for EASI, the Developer Center and the Partner Product Portal. (Getting Started with Product · Discover EASI Portal Login · FAQ · Discover Partner Product Portal)
For
Issuers: large banks (direct licensees), Acquirers and processors, Developers and technology service providers

How it works, by partner type

Issuers: large banks (direct licensees)

NetworkHow it worksTools and screensFriction
VisaA regional licensing team first confirms eligibility. The applicant then gets Visa Access credentials and completes the application in the Client Lifecycle Management Tool (Visa's Licensing Program). During review the organisation holds a temporary UVID. A final Business ID is issued on approval (Visa's Licensing Program). Visa reviews regulatory permissions, AML and ATF programmes with a compliance questionnaire, credit and settlement risk, and risk management. The settlement review repeats every year (Visa's Licensing Program). A Principal licenses and uses only its own BIN. Each BIN has exactly one licensee, which answers for all activity on it and pays the numeric ID fees (Visa Core Rules). Within 10 business days of a BIN going live, the member enters contacts in the Client Directory on Visa Access. These name a Directory Manager, Primary Center Manager and Senior Officer (Visa Core Rules). Brand use sits under the Visa-owned marks licence. Visa may ask to review any branded material, and Europe requires a card design self-certification form (Visa Core Rules · Visa Physical Card Brand).Visa Access, Client Lifecycle Management Tool. Where the licence application is completed after eligibility is confirmed, with a temporary UVID shown during review (Visa's Licensing Program). Client Directory (Client Service Provider Directory and My Organization's Contacts modules). Member contacts and named roles, due within 10 business days of a BIN or BID implementation (Visa Core Rules). Visa Partner account and Universal Login. One identity across Visa Developer, Visa Partner programmes and Visa Online, with extra validation for Visa Online (Visa Partner Support).Eligibility rules live in charter documents outside the public rulebook, so an applicant cannot self-assess before contacting Visa (Visa Core Rules). Principal service fees and any licensing timeline are unpublished (Visa's Licensing Program). Several partner pages still name Visa Online after its rename to Visa Access, which leaves two names for one portal (Visa Core Rules).
MastercardAn applicant must be a regulated financial institution with an acceptable business plan. Mastercard admits applicants at its sole discretion and alone decides Principal or Affiliate status (Mastercard Rules). The application is the public Universal Onboarding Template, form 1400, titled an application for the licence to use Mastercard service marks (Mastercard Send Registration). AML and sanctions programmes are a licence condition. Named compliance contacts are kept in My Company Manager (Mastercard Rules). Mastercard may demand capital, collateral or escrow. It may also let an applicant operate on an interim basis while the application is pending (Mastercard Rules). Each customer receives an ICA. The ICA and BIN must reflect the country of activity within the licensed Area of Use, and adding a country means a new application (Definitions · Mastercard Rules). Connect access for a new company starts with the Mastercard Connect Access Form, 1145 or 1145b, obtained from a representative (Mastercard Send Registration).Universal Onboarding Template, form 1400. A public Qualtrics form for a new licensed customer application (Mastercard Send Registration). Mastercard Connect, My Company Manager. Company records, contacts per ICA, AML and sanctions contacts, and service provider registration (Mastercard Rules). Mastercard Connect sign-up. A three-step request that ends with approval by the applicant company's own administrator (Mastercard Connect).The live rulebook and brand pages refuse automated fetches, and the old public licensing guide survives only as a legacy page (Licensing Guide · Find a payment facilitator). Joining and registration fees sit in the Pricing and Billing Center behind Connect (Mastercard Rules).
American ExpressThere is no public application. Rulebooks are handed over only after an agreement is signed (American Express Global Network). The first eligibility rule is a Participant Agreement that authorises issuing under assigned BIN ranges (Business and Operational Policies). Bank partners must pass capital and soundness tests and hold an investment-grade rating, or post a guarantee, letter of credit or cash collateral (Business and Operational Policies). Before launch American Express certifies specifications and assigns settlement parameters, currency code and participant number ranges. It also works with the partner's marketing agency (Business and Operational Policies). A site survey, vulnerability scanning and any required site review come before beta test (Business and Operational Policies). Participants are classed as Network Card License issuers, Independent Operators or Joint Ventures. Fees are negotiated bilaterally in each agreement (Business and Operational Policies). Brand use runs under a Trademark Licensing Agreement. Issuers pay a monthly rental fee for each active BIN, USD 175 in the 2023 manual (Business and Operational Policies).Knowledge Base. Gated home for manuals, the Participant Directory and Service Enrollment for network services after licensing (Partners · Business and Operational Policies). Navigator training via Knowledge Base. Mandatory training before staff reach FraudNet, Network Disputes Manager and Program Progress Report (Business and Operational Policies). User access forms and online enrolment. Per-person system access, with business justification and manager approval, coordinated by the AEGNS Operations Manager (Business and Operational Policies).Obligations cannot be read before signing because the policy manual is confidential (American Express Global Network). The public contact route is a web form that returns a case number, with no phone or email published (Contact Us).
Discover familyDiscover describes network partner agreements with financial institutions, fintechs and alliance networks. Prospects use a nine-category contact form (Discover 10-K 2024 · Contact Us). The partnering page offers consultation with no steps, fees or timelines (How We Partner). Diners Club issuers hold a Network Participation Agreement or a sublicence NPA. Prospects email a brand mailbox (About Diners Club · Diners Club International Issuing · Diners Club Issuing). The Partner Product Portal's Going Live flow has five stages: Organization Identification, Legal and Risk Documentation, Configuration, Certification, and End to End Testing (Discover Partner Product Portal).Discover Partner Product Portal, Going Live. Five named onboarding stages seen in the site's code. The page renders only client side (Discover Partner Product Portal · Discover Partner Product Portal). Diners Club issuer resources on ServiceNow. Assets and tools for current Diners issuers only (Get Started).Operating rules and specifications sit behind the Service Center login, with no public rulebook (Discover Global Network). Diners Club issuer interchange is negotiated per issuer, with no published schedule (Capital One 10-K 2025).

Best pattern. Visa's licensing page publishes four steps, the review criteria and the identifier a partner holds during review. It is the clearest public map of a direct licence (Visa's Licensing Program). Discover today. Discover routes issuers to a contact form or a Diners brand mailbox. Its five-stage Going Live structure exists in code but is not visible as a readable page (Contact Us · Diners Club International Issuing · Discover Partner Product Portal).

What public sources could not show

  1. Visa Access Client Lifecycle Management Tool screens, statuses and fields It sits behind Visa Access, and no republished guide was found. Search for bank or credit union training decks and Visa webinar captions that show the tool.
  2. Mastercard My Company Manager service provider registration screens Mastercard's public external guide returned HTTP 403 and has no Wayback copy. Look for sponsor bank or processor procedure documents that quote the guide.
  3. Fields of Mastercard form 1400 The brief bars opening or typing into forms, so only the title was read. Look for consultancy or bank checklists that list the questions.
  4. American Express 360Connect and Knowledge Base Service Enrollment Both are gated, and only the OptBlue regulations describe them. Look for OptBlue sales agent material and participant webinars.
  5. Discover EASI Registration Guide The linked PDF returned an application error on 26 September 2026. Retry the link later or check for a Wayback capture.
  6. Discover acquirer, ISO and payment facilitator registration rules Discover operating regulations are not public and its guide routes payment facilitators to acquirers. Look for processor help pages that cite Discover registration steps.
  7. PULSE participation agreement terms and fees PULSE confirms fees in filings but publishes no amounts or agreement. Look in credit union board packets and state regulator filings.
  8. Current Visa and Mastercard agent registration fees Visa's last public figures are from 2016 and Mastercard points to its gated billing centre. Look in sponsor bank ISO agreements filed with the SEC.
  9. Elapsed time from application to licence No network publishes a licensing timeline. Compare signing and launch dates in partner press releases.

Onboard and certify

Every network puts a signed contract or a reviewed request before certification, then builds the test cases from each partner's own configuration (Going Live · Onboarding Checklist (Mastercom) · Getting Started · Discover Partner Product Portal · EMV Testing and Certification · Getting Started with Product). Visa and Mastercard hand user provisioning to administrators inside the partner. Mastercard wants one Business Administrator and two Security Administrators, named on a form sent by email (Mastercard Connect Overview 2022 · Mastercard Connect Access 1145b · Visa Enrollment Manager (VEM) · Visa Access Support). Host certification is still led by a network representative. Visa's published host path runs from a CIQ and testing questionnaire through attended VCMS testing to a letter and production flags (Visa Smart Debit/Credit). Each network closes certification with a different artefact. Mastercard sends a TAN letter, Visa a completion letter or a CCRT email, Discover a letter listing cases, and Amex a summary plus live terminal parameters (EMV Testing and Certification). All four run self-certification or accredited third-party routes for terminals. These routes are how processors and platforms certify once for many clients (EMV Testing and Certification). The clearest progress tracking in public view belongs to Amex's AMEX Enabled dashboard for vendors and UnionPay's project record. Mastercard and Visa show tracking for access orders and admin tasks (AMEX Enabled Overview · Getting Started with Product · Mastercard Connect Overview 2022 · Visa Enrollment Manager (VEM)). Published turnarounds are few and cover the network's own steps. Examples are EASI review in two business days, PULSE credentials in five, Amex Knowledge Base access in three and a Mastercard CIS project number in several days (EASI Portal Registration Guide · Log In / Register · Knowledge Base · MDES Token Connect · Mastercom Onboarding Checklist). The Discover family onboards partners through separate doors: EASI, the PULSE website, a representative-gated Developer Center, the Partner Product Portal and Service Center fraud forms (Discover EASI Portal Login · Log In / Register · FAQs · Discover Partner Product Portal · Fraud and Risk Center). Friction concentrates in scheduling and review time, retest triggers when anything in the chain changes, and failed certification windows (Options for Reducing Level · ISO 8583 Certification Testing · Visa Smart Debit/Credit · EMV Testing and Certification). Certification for US domestic debit networks, PULSE included, is almost absent from the public record. The industry's shared certification guide leaves those networks out (EMV Testing and Certification · Log In / Register · Move money to make).

Design moves at this stage

3.1One certification record with an owner on every stepStrong evidence
The move
Keep one project record per partner that both the partner and network staff read. Each step shows its owner, state and sign-off. Show a service level only where the network commits to one.
Why it wins
AMEX Enabled and UnionPay show certification progress. In public sources Visa and Mastercard track only access orders and admin tasks, so a shared record would lead them. Visa splits ownership between a client support representative and a testing representative, so each step needs a named role. (AMEX Enabled Overview · Getting Started with Product · Mastercard Connect Overview 2022 · Visa Enrollment Manager (VEM) · Discover Partner Product Portal · Visa Token Service Technical)
For
all
3.2Live simulator results with a committed reviewStrong evidence
The move
Build on Discover's designated simulator. Let partners self-test any time, see each case pass or fail, and hand the batch to Discover review under a stated service level.
Why it wins
Discover and Amex already give live results, and a vendor reports that failed certification windows cost weeks or months elsewhere. The request form already flags wrong and unexpected entries by colour, so that validation can run in the portal as the partner types. (EMV Testing and Certification · Level 3 Testing · ISO 8583 Certification Testing · D-PAS Terminal End-to-End Letter)
For
Acquirers and acquirer processors, Processors, gateways and platforms certifying for many clients, Merchants connecting directly
3.3One door for the Discover familyStrong evidence
The move
Put EASI, PULSE, the Developer Center and fraud product enrolment behind one registration and one record.
Why it wins
This brings parity with Visa and Mastercard, which link partner identities. The earlier study infers that sign-in alone is unlikely to win partners. (Discover EASI Portal Login · Log In / Register · FAQs · Fraud and Risk Center · Visa Partner Support · Company Verification · GitHub issues · Stack Overflow)
For
all
3.4Publish the network's own service levelsStrong evidence
The move
State turnarounds for steps Discover controls, such as access review and result review, with an escalation route. Keep partner-paced durations out.
Why it wins
Mastercard and Amex already publish such commitments, and Visa says timing is the first question clients ask. (Mastercom Onboarding Checklist · Mastercom, Mastercard Developers · American Express Developers · Knowledge Base · EASI Portal Registration Guide · Visa Developer Onboarding)
For
all
3.5A wallet of certification lettersModerate evidence
The move
Store every letter, its tested configuration and its expiry in the record. Let a partner share proof with a client or reuse it on a new implementation.
Why it wins
Letters differ by network, Visa gives none for L3, and Mastercard's TAN is reusable. One portable record would save repeat proof. A real D-PAS letter carries a project ID, test plan versions and waivers with expiry dates, so the wallet should track waiver expiry too. (EMV Testing and Certification · Chip Card Testing · D-PAS Terminal End-to-End Letter)
For
Acquirers and acquirer processors, Processors, gateways and platforms certifying for many clients, Payment facilitators and ISOs
3.6A retest check before any changeModerate evidence
The move
Turn the networks' agreed retest rules into a check. The partner describes a change and sees whether it is minor, needs internal regression or needs network testing.
Why it wins
The rules are published as a forum FAQ with no interactive check. Retest triggers and multiplied certifications are named friction points. Discover's request form already lists the events that trigger terminal recertification, which gives the check a ready rule set. (EMV Testing and Certification · Options for Reducing Level · Visa Smart Debit/Credit · D-PAS Terminal End-to-End Letter)
For
Acquirers and acquirer processors, ATM operators, Processors, gateways and platforms certifying for many clients, Payment facilitators and ISOs
3.7Certify once, inherit across clientsModerate evidence
The move
Show which clients inherit a processor's certification and which need their own tests. Let a client accept a processor registration without re-entering it.
Why it wins
Visa registers an agent separately per acquirer, while Mastercard's Modular M-TIP and Product Express show reuse works. Thredd's standard token set-up needs no network testing by clients, which shows inheritance already working at processor level. (Visa Core Rules · EMV Testing and Certification · Mastercard Product Express · Card Network Certifications 2026 · Tokenisation Service Guide, Version)
For
Processors, gateways and platforms certifying for many clients, Fintechs and programme managers
3.8Administrator set-up inside the productModerate evidence
The move
Let the signatory name administrators in the product with no emailed form. Offer a preset of tools by partner type, and let the partner admin provision its processor with consent.
Why it wins
Mastercard uses an emailed form and Visa a hand-passed password. A BaaS platform publishes its own list of the Connect apps a bank needs. (Mastercard Connect Access 1145b · Visa Enrollment Manager (VEM) · Register for Mastercard Connect · PULSE Reporting)
For
Issuers: large banks, Issuers: community banks and credit unions, Fintechs and programme managers
3.9The ATM chain in one viewThin evidence
The move
Show the sponsor bank, ISO, processor and each network registration for an operator's fleet, with location upkeep in the same record.
Why it wins
Operators reach networks through sponsors and ISOs, and Mastercard requires quarterly location updates in a separate tool. (BSA/AML Manual · Mastercard Rules · Client Support · Cardtronics USA, Inc. v.)
For
ATM operators
