Gated network specifications and implementation guides needed for host certification (American Express Certification).Amex's published certification steps all start with the relationship manager (American Express Certification · EMV Testing and Certification).
Discover familyDiscover host certification has a D-PAS online authorisation test and a clearing test, run on Discover's designated simulator (EMV Testing and Certification). The acquirer sends a host certification request form, and Discover assigns test cases from it (EMV Testing and Certification). A separate form registers security officers to receive CA public keys, and all forms come from the implementation manager (EMV Testing and Certification). Acquirers see simulator results immediately and need not submit logs, and Discover reviews results within agreed service levels (EMV Testing and Certification). Terminal E2E runs through an accredited service provider, which drafts the Letter of Certification for Discover's approval (EMV Testing and Certification). Discover gives up to ten full sets of test cards free (EMV Testing and Certification). The Terminal E2E Certification Request Form is filled in for each combination of kernel, payment application and terminal-to-acquirer interface. Its answers decide the assigned test cases (D-PAS Terminal End-to-End Letter). The form lists the events that need terminal certification, such as a new or changed kernel, payment application or chip-related peripheral (D-PAS Terminal End-to-End Letter).EASI Portal. Specifications, developer test card kits, announcements and a Message Center to operations (Get Started). Designated host test simulator. Self-service host testing with immediate results (EMV Testing and Certification). Release Compliance Tool. Listed under Test and Certify on the Partner Product Portal (Discover Partner Product Portal). Terminal E2E Certification Request Form (DN v7.2). Colour-coded worksheet of customer details, scope, Quick Chip choice, expansion brands, kernel approvals, terminal set-up and deployment counts. Red marks wrong entries (D-PAS Terminal End-to-End Letter). D-PAS Terminal E2E Letter of Certification. Project ID, full or recertification, scope, terminal and software, test tool, test plan versions, service provider and a waiver table with expiry dates (D-PAS Terminal End-to-End Letter).Forms and the qualified tool list are obtained from the implementation manager, not downloaded (EMV Testing and Certification). Waivers carry an expiry date and cover only terminal certification, so an open host fix must be tracked outside the letter (D-PAS Terminal End-to-End Letter). Errors in a letter are corrected through a named D-PAS Deployment Manager (D-PAS Terminal End-to-End Letter).

Best pattern. Discover's designated simulator lets acquirers test at any time and see results immediately, while Discover reviews within agreed service levels (EMV Testing and Certification). Discover today. Discover matches peers on self-certification and per-acquirer cases, and gives live simulator results as Amex does with ATS. Its forms come through an implementation manager, and no turnaround is public (EMV Testing and Certification).

Processors, gateways and platforms certifying for many clients

NetworkHow it worksTools and screensFriction
VisaVisa's Chip Vendor Enabled Service lets third-party vendors run L3 testing for acquirers and their processors (EMV Testing and Certification). The self-accreditation programme lets acquirers and processors run L3 on their own, and US members skip submitting reports (EMV Testing and Certification · Level 3 Testing). Each acquirer registers a merchant's third party agent separately, so a processor serving many acquirers is registered many times (Visa Core Rules). From 24 October 2026, US and Canadian members must also disclose the BINs and account ranges each agent uses (Visa Core Rules). Visa Ready is the certification route for issuer processors, BIN sponsors, programme managers, acquirers and gateways (Visa Ready Program). A non-client processor needs an executed Exhibit K on file before Visa shares its host specifications (V.I.P. System BASE I).Visa Ready and Visa Partner. Six-step application ending in certification and a public directory listing (Visa Ready Program · Visa Partner directory).Visa Ready Tap to Phone certification typically takes six to twelve months, and lab testing can cost 50,000 dollars or more (Tap to Phone).

Modular M-TIP certifies terminals and host components separately, and certified combinations then deploy without further testing (EMV Testing and Certification). Under US Delegated L3 Testing, approved acquirers validate M-TIP internally for their VARs, ISOs and gateways (EMV Testing and Certification). Each customer registers its service providers in My Company Manager, with materials due within 30 days and annual revalidation (Mastercard Rules). A token service provider must pass Mastercard certification before a customer may register it (Mastercard Rules). Issuer processors certify against each Mastercard release, named by year and quarter (Card Network Certifications 2026 · Card Network Certifications 2026).My Company Manager. Service provider registrations, BINs, account ranges and compliance contacts (Mastercard Rules).Service provider registration carries an initial and annual fee whose amounts are not published in the rules (Mastercard Rules).
American ExpressService providers join AMEX Enabled by registering the company under click-through NDA and terms, enrolling a Knowledge Base user and entering the dashboard (Partners · AMEX Enabled Service Provider). Registration is free and is not approval, since each product must still pass certification (AMEX Enabled Frequently Asked · AMEX Enabled Service Provider). Processors using a host simulator other than ATS must meet Approved Solution Provider requirements at their own cost (EMV Testing and Certification). Test labs need EMVCo accreditation before they can register for AMEX Enabled accreditation (AMEX Enabled Test Laboratory).AMEX Enabled Dashboard. Step-by-step journey position, a document set per product, user invitations and status monitoring (AMEX Enabled Overview). Contract Center. DocuSign contracts with progress tracked at company and product level (AMEX Enabled Overview). Messaging Center. Document exchange and support from Amex product specialists (AMEX Enabled Frequently Asked · AMEX Enabled Service Provider).The 2022 overview allows five additional users per provider on the dashboard (AMEX Enabled Service Provider).
Discover familyUnder AMTC an acquirer validates its own E2E results, and its service provider is accredited indirectly through that acquirer (EMV Testing and Certification). Discover accredits acquirers for AMTC case by case (EMV Testing and Certification). Marqeta completes Discover mandate work for its clients without changes on their side (Card Network Certifications 2026). The request form names the platform, merchants and VAR or gateway, and those details are printed on the letter (D-PAS Terminal End-to-End Letter). Under the 2011 rules a processor had to be certified before settling funds to merchants (Discover Merchant Operating Regulations).Partner Directory. Products that have passed Discover type approval (Partner Directory).The type approval process itself is not described publicly (Partner Directory).
Cross-networkA POS solution tested once on an acquiring platform generally covers every acquirer on that platform (EMV Testing and Certification). Twice-yearly releases need no full recertification unless a network asks. A move to a new message format is a major change that needs the networks involved (EMV Testing and Certification).None found in publicCombinations of POS systems, devices and acquirers multiply the certifications one software version needs (Options for Reducing Level).

Best pattern. Mastercard's Modular M-TIP and Fast Track turn one certification into reusable components across acquirers (EMV Testing and Certification). Discover today. Discover's AMTC programme accredits processors indirectly and case by case, and processors report few Discover mandate changes. Its type approval steps are not public (EMV Testing and Certification · Card Network Certifications 2026 · Partner Directory).

What public sources could not show

  1. Visa Access screens for CCRT, Program Request Management and the eCIQ Behind login, and no republished user guide was found Search bank and processor sites for republished Visa guides like the RBC copy of the VEM guide, and Visa Access help videos
  2. Current Visa host certification with VCMS and the Global Client Testing team The only public step list is Visa's 2016 acquirer guide Processor implementation guides, Visa job postings for testing roles, and the current Visa L3 guidelines in the DPS library
  3. Mastercard Technical Resource Center manuals such as the NIV guide, CITR and Service Provider Registration Guide Gated behind Mastercard Connect Wayback captures and copies republished by banks and processors
  4. Whether Mastercard CIS shows partners a project status Public pages name the CIS project number but no tracking screen CIS job postings, customer webinars and partner interviews
  5. Amex merchant specifications and certification portal The page is script-rendered and blocks the text tool Read it in a normal browser session without signing in
  6. Inside EASI, including the Message Center and test card request forms Registration and approval are needed Ask an entitled partner for a walkthrough
  7. PULSE certification steps for issuers, processors and ATM acquirers No public source describes them, and the industry guide excludes domestic debit PULSE operating rules via processors, PULSE implementation job postings and client interviews
  8. The D-PAS Certification Manual and Discover's type approval process Available only through an implementation manager Test lab service sheets that describe Discover certification
  9. Issuer token onboarding at Visa and Mastercard VTS documentation is restricted and the MDES guide sits in the TRC Issuer processor developer docs and network webinars
  10. Actual elapsed time partners experience from contract to live Only network-stated ranges and vendor estimates are public Partner interviews and forum threads from processors

Build and integrate

Visa and Mastercard let any registered developer create a project and call a sandbox the same day, and production waits on a contract or company verification (Pricing on Visa Developer · Quick Start Guide · Going Live). American Express reviews every product request before keys appear, and Discover's Developer Center admits developers only by a representative's invitation (Getting Started · American Express Developers · FAQ · Developers Guide, section). The ISO 8583 host specifications that acquirers build to are marked confidential at all four networks. The networks distribute them behind Visa Online, Mastercard Connect, the Amex Knowledge Base or EASI (Visa Core Rules · Mastercard Rules · API Basics · American Express Certification · Get Started · EASI Portal Registration Guide). Host certification is representative-led everywhere. Discover and American Express hand out forms and test plans through a named manager, and Mastercard needs licensed simulators ordered on Mastercard Connect (EMV Testing and Certification). Token services are the least self-serve surface. Visa's VTS page routes to an account executive or acquirer, MDES issuer work runs through a Mastercard delivery manager, and Amex notification tests need a representative (Visa Token Service · Getting Started · Amex Token Service Guide). Processors and programme managers carry most integration for smaller partners. Host testing runs once per platform, and Marqeta certifies each network release for all its clients (EMV Testing and Certification · Card Network Certifications 2026 · Card Network Mandates). Discover's strongest public asset is twelve readable OpenAPI specifications on the Partner Product Portal, but the credentials, test cases and certification behind them are released by people (Issuer Card Account Services · Going Live with Discover · Business Users Guide). The public record is thin for PULSE, which publishes no developer portal, API reference or interface specification (Why PULSE · Debit Processing & Gateways).

Design moves at this stage

4.1A sandbox key on the first visitStrong evidence
The move
Let a signed-up developer create a project, get sandbox credentials and published test cards, and call the twelve existing APIs without a representative.
Why it wins
It reaches Visa and Mastercard parity and moves ahead of American Express's key review. It replaces Discover's invitation step, the largest gap found. (Pricing on Visa Developer · Quick Start Guide · American Express Developers · FAQ · Developers Guide, section · Issuer Card Account Services · Testing Guide)
For
developers, fintechs, payfacs and ISVs, merchants
4.2Certification as a shared project recordStrong evidence
The move
Generate the case list from the partner's stated configuration, collect results in the portal, and show who owns each step.
Why it wins
Mastercard's MDES asks for an Excel file by email and Discover's forms come from a manager. UnionPay already links tests and confirmations in one project. Mastercard's issuer case tables already mark each case for simulator or MTF, which a record could turn into a checklist. (Test Result Submission · EMV Testing and Certification · Getting Started with Product · Issuer Mastercard and Debit)
For
acquirers and processors, issuers, token requestors
4.3Build for the processor as the customerStrong evidence
The move
Let a processor create projects on behalf of clients, manage them through an API, and show which clients inherit its certification.
Why it wins
Host testing runs once per platform and processors already publish per-release impact. Among the portals read, Mastercard offers an 'on behalf of a client' flag and a portal API. (Quick Start Guide · Platform Overview · EMV Testing and Certification · Card Network Certifications 2026 · Card Network Mandates)
For
processors, community banks and credit unions, fintechs and programme managers
4.4Specifications by entitlement, versioned and diffableModerate evidence
The move
Serve the host specification to entitled users as searchable pages with a per-release change list, and publish a public field map for feasibility.
Why it wins
All four networks gate specs as manuals, while Mastercard shows a public mapping works. Processors staff teams to turn releases into requirements. Mastercard marks changes with *chg* tags found by PDF search, and Discover posted specifications on its website in 2011. (Visa Core Rules · Mastercard Rules · American Express Global Network · Get Started · Test Data Mapping cain.002.001.02 · Program Manager, Card Network · Notification of Specification Changes · Customer Interface Specification · Discover Merchant Operating Regulations)
For
acquirers and processors, issuers
4.5Token requestor onboarding without emailModerate evidence
The move
Issue a token requestor ID and register notification endpoints in the portal, and route to PULSE Side-by-Side from the same flow.
Why it wins
Visa Acceptance, Amex and Mastercard each insert an email or representative step. Discover owns a routable debit token others lack. (Network Token Onboarding, Partner · Amex Token Service Guide · Getting Started · PULSE Side-by-Side Token Service · PULSE Payments Network)
For
merchants, wallets, PSPs
4.6One entry for every Discover build surfaceModerate evidence
The move
Put the Developer Center, Partner Product Portal, EASI, Release Compliance Tool and Advanced Payments behind one sign-in and one project.
Why it wins
Visa and Mastercard link identities, and two Discover portals already share an identity provider. The study classes this as parity. It removes friction without giving a partner a reason to join. (Discover Partner Product Portal · Fraud and Risk Center · Discover Partner Product Portal · Visa Partner Support · Company Verification)
For
all
4.7Credentials that do not strand the developerModerate evidence
The move
Allow re-download or self-service reissue of keys and certificates, with renewal reminders in every environment.
Why it wins
Visa and Discover make keys one-time downloads, and Visa reminds only certification and production projects. Mastercard now automates production mTLS certificates. (Visa Developer Tutorial · Discover Partner Product Portal · Frequently Asked Questions · Blog · Quick Start Guide)
For
developers, token requestors
4.8Docs readable by coding assistantsModerate evidence
The move
Publish llms.txt, markdown twins of each page and a documentation MCP server.
Why it wins
Mastercard and Visa already do this, and Discover's portals return 404 or a bare title to a fetching tool. (Working with llms.txt · Mastercard Developers Agent Toolkit · Documentation MCP Server · VisaAcceptance Developer Center · 404 Not Found · Discover Stored Token Services)
For
developers
4.9State the network's own service levelsModerate evidence
The move
Show Discover's commitments on its own steps, such as registration review, and give each an escalation route.
Why it wins
Discover already states a two-day EASI review and PULSE five days. Mastercard pairs its service levels with escalation channels. (EASI Portal Registration Guide · Log · Mastercom, Mastercard Developers · American Express Developers)
For
all
4.10Public status and webhook contractsModerate evidence
The move
Publish API status per environment and document webhook retries, signing and subscriptions.
Why it wins
Mastercard and Visa Acceptance run public status pages and document retries. Discover publishes no webhook retry detail, and no Discover status page was found. (API Status · Visa Acceptance Solutions Status · Set Up Your Webhook · Webhooks · Discover Partner Product Portal · Discover Developer Center, walked)
For
developers, processors, token requestors

How it works, by partner type

Developers building on network APIs (independent developers, fintech engineering teams, integrators)

NetworkHow it worksTools and screensFriction
VisaA developer registers on developer.visa.com with name, email, organisation and company website, then signs in through Visa's Universal Login with MFA or a passkey (Visa Developer Center, walked · Frequently Asked Questions). From the dashboard the developer clicks Add new project, names it, picks an API such as Visa Transaction Controls, selects 'Generate a CSR for me' and clicks Create project (Visa Developer Tutorial). A pop-up then offers the certificate private key, which can be downloaded only once (Visa Developer Tutorial). The Credentials tab shows the project client certificate, common certificates including the Visa Developer Platform root, and a user ID and password for HTTP Basic authentication (Tutorial: How to Connect · Going Live). The first call is Hello World over Two-Way SSL, tested in Postman or in SoapUI after building a keystore with OpenSSL (Tutorial: How to Connect · Get Credentials to Start · Two-Way SSL). Each API authenticates with Two-Way SSL or X-Pay Token, and some add message level encryption with JWE (Visa Developer Quick Start · Message Level Encryption). Mock test data sits in a Test Data table per API inside the project, and it never touches VisaNet (Visa Developer Tutorial · Visa Developer Quick Start). Restricted products carry a lock and need a Request Access application that a Visa admin reviews before the API can join a project (Visa Developer Quick Start · Browse Products). To go live the developer opens Going live in the project, registers the company or enters a Visa BID, adds contacts and beneficial owners, and describes the use case (Visa Developer Tutorial). A product team reviews the request with no stated timeline, then sends a contract with pricing and terms (Visa Developer Tutorial). Certification and production credentials need a new CSR per environment and appear only after signature, behind an emailed one-time password (Going Live).API browser (/apibrowser). 73 product cards with Overview and Docs links, filters by audience and capability, and lock icons on 20 restricted products (Browse Products · Visa Developer Center, walked). Project dashboard. Left navigation with Summary, Credentials, Configurations, Test Data, Users, Project Settings and Sample Code (Create a Project · Visa Developer Tutorial). Going live form and Onboarding Dashboard. Company registration or Visa BID, contacts, beneficial ownership, use case questions, geography, then Submit going live request (Visa Developer Tutorial · Going Live · Visa Developer Center). VDC Playground. A Windows-only Java tester downloaded from Asset Management inside a signed-in project (Visa Developer Center Playground). Release notes. Monthly entries by year from 2017, each tagged Public or Restricted (Release Notes).The private key can be downloaded only once, so a lost key means a new project (Visa Developer Tutorial). APIs cannot be removed from a sandbox project, so a wrong pick also means a new project (Create a Project). SDKs, sample code and implementation guides are downloads behind sign-in (Visa Developer Quick Start). Visa says onboarding can take two weeks or several months, and its product team states no review timeline (Visa Developer Onboarding · Visa Developer Tutorial). Visa says timing is the first question on nearly every client's mind (Visa Developer Onboarding). No numeric rate limits are published and load testing is prohibited (Visa Developer Error Codes · Terms of Use).
MastercardA developer signs up with email, password, name, company and country, verifies the email and logs in (Quick Start Guide · Mastercard Developers, walked). On My Projects the developer clicks Create new project, enters details, says whether the project is built for a client, selects APIs and clicks Proceed (Quick Start Guide). The portal generates credentials, often a consumer key and an RSA key pair made in the browser, and Open Project starts Sandbox testing (Quick Start Guide · Using OAuth 1.0a). Mastercard's own video shows sandbox keys on the dashboard straight after project creation (Mastercard News). Most services use OAuth 1.0a with RSA-SHA256 signing, and a few use OAuth 2.0 with FAPI 2.0 or mutual TLS (Authentication · Mastercard Developers llms.txt). The quick start offers three routes: an API tool such as Postman or Insomnia, Mastercard SDK samples, or a client generated from the downloadable OpenAPI spec (Quick Start Guide · Generating and Configuring · Postman Collection). Before production the developer verifies the company, instant when linked to Mastercard Connect or a Company ID, and declares commercial countries (Company Verification · Quick Start Guide). Request Production access generates credentials at once, and they activate only after Mastercard approves (Quick Start Guide).Product catalogue (/products). 91 products with category and 'Used by' filters, each with Overview and Documentation links (Mastercard Developers). Documentation sidebar. Overview, Announcements, Quick Start Guide, API Basics, API Reference, Developer Tools, Testing, Onboarding Checklist, Tutorials and Support, with a Copy to Markdown control (Mastercard Developers, walked). Create new project screen. Project details, an 'on behalf of a client' question, API selection and credential generation (Quick Start Guide). Project Summary page. Production access prerequisites for company verification and commercial countries, then Request Production access (Quick Start Guide). API Status page. Per-service health for Sandbox and Production, polled about once a minute (API Status). Agent toolkit. A public MCP server and llms.txt so coding assistants can read docs and specs (Mastercard Developers Agent Toolkit · Working with llms.txt).Some sandboxes sit 'Under Review' until a service team approves, and a forum post shows a correctly signed call failing at 'SANDBOX Pending' (Quick Start Guide · Receiving 403 while consuming). There is no portal-wide set of test cards, and some products need a representative to configure them (Test Cards for Mastercard). Keys expire after 13 months, and two documents disagree on the reminder schedule (Quick Start Guide). Direct support tickets need sign-in (Support at Mastercard Developers).
American ExpressA developer clicks Sign Up, creates an Amex OneID login and sets a six-to-nine-digit security code (Getting Started). The product then sits in Requested until Amex approves it, and only then do the Client ID and Client Secret appear (Getting Started · American Express Developers). Partner applications use mutual TLS with Amex-signed certificates from an uploaded CSR, plus OAuth 2 or HMAC request signing (Amex Signed Certificates · OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials · Hash-Based Message Authentication Code). An Approved sandbox integration shows a Move to Production link, which reopens the To Do list and a second review (Getting Started).Products menu. To Do items, product status Requested or Approved, keys per product per environment, and Move to Production (Getting Started · American Express Developers). Create Support Ticket. A form usable signed out, with seven categories and two 1 MB attachments (American Express Developers helpdesk · American Express Developers).No product offers instant sandbox access, although the documentation says some do (High-Level Process). Five products hide their specification behind an invitation (Account and Transaction API). The Java and .NET SDKs are header helpers last updated in 2020 and 2018 (amex-api-java-client-core · amex-api-dotnet-client-core). The portal's What's New log stopped in May 2024 (What's New).

After approval Discover creates a Developer Center organisation and an application with client credentials and a Sandbox, Certification or Prod API Plan (Going Live with Discover). The same process repeats for production and issues new credentials (Developers Guide, section). Requests carry an OAuth 2 token plus an X-DFS-API-PLAN header, and many APIs add a second factor, mutual TLS and JWE or JWS payload protection (Going Live with Discover · Discover Partner Product Portal · Developers Guide, section). The Partner Product Portal publishes an OpenAPI document for each of its twelve products to signed-out readers (Issuer Card Account Services · Discover Partner Product Portal).Partner Product Portal, Explore our APIs. Twelve products in six groups, each with Overview and API Specs tabs (Discover Partner Product Portal · Discover Partner Product Portal). Going Live with Discover. A Business Users Guide with a four-phase activity table and a twelve-section Developers Guide on registration, keys, OAuth and encryption (Going Live with Discover · Developers Guide). Developer Center FAQ and Contact Us. Answers that route every new user to a representative (FAQs · Discover Developer Center, walked).Developer Center documentation pages return 403 to signed-out readers (Access denied). No sandbox is reachable without an invitation, and no changelog, status page or llms.txt was found (FAQ · Discover Partner Product Portal · 404 Not Found · Discover Developer Center, walked). The Consumer Application Certificate downloads only once, and a replacement needs a request (Discover Partner Product Portal). UnionpayUnionPay's Open Platform signs members in with their institution portal account and pre-fills onboarding tasks with data UnionPay holds (UnionPay International Open Platform · Getting Started with Product). Its test tasks are generated from the project's confirmed business, technical and network information (Getting Started with Product).UnionPay Open Platform project. Project nodes that activate once a support manager is assigned, with test reports linked from the testing platform (Getting Started with Product).A new project's steps stay inactive until the local office assigns a project support manager (Getting Started with Product).

Best pattern. Mastercard gives the shortest path to a first call. It pairs a same-day sandbox with open markdown docs and an MCP server, and keys the production gate to an existing client identity (Quick Start Guide · Working with llms.txt · Mastercard Developers Agent Toolkit · Company Verification). Discover today. Discover publishes readable OpenAPI specifications but gates the sandbox behind a representative's invitation, so a developer cannot make a first call unaided. Inference: the Partner Product Portal already has projects and credentials switched on to build from (Issuer Card Account Services · FAQ · Developers Guide, section · Discover Partner Product Portal).

Acquirers, acquirer processors and gateways (host integration and certification)

NetworkHow it worksTools and screensFriction
VisaA member that uses a processor submits a regional client information questionnaire, and a non-member processor signs a VisaNet Letter of Agreement before touching V.I.P. or BASE II (Visa Core Rules). Large acquiring platforms hire engineers to build Visa and Mastercard authorisation and clearing flows in ISO 8583 (Software Engineer, Payins Card). VisaNet documentation is confidential, and members must stop staff sharing it with third parties (Visa Core Rules). BASE I, the V.I.P. authorisation format, is ISO 8583:1987 with many Visa additions, according to a third-party tooling site ([DONE] Visa BASE I). Terminal testing connects to the Visa Certification Management Service or a Visa-confirmed simulator, and a completion letter closes host testing (EMV Testing and Certification). Visa's newer VisaNet Connect Acceptance offers a REST authorisation API on ISO 20022, with no ISO 8583 mapping on its public pages (Getting Started with VisaNet). Each Visa guide names the Business Enhancements release it reflects. Changes arrive through Global Technical Letters and Implementation Guides (Visa Token Service Technical). A centre must sign off from VisaNet whenever its authorisation system is down (V.I.P. System Overview).Visa Online, now Visa Access. The gated client site holding host test scripts, risk standards and service enrolment, granted at BID level (EMV Testing and Certification · Log · Visa Ecosystem Risk Programs). Visa Digital Partner Services. Approval Services Portal and Tap to Phone Certification Portal for chip product testing (Home). Visa testing guides. Client versions of the VCMS V.I.P. Testing Guide, VCMS Testing Guide for BASE II and VisaNet Testing Guide (Visa Token Service Technical).Level 3 testing is mandatory and separate from vendor approvals (ProductTestingOverview). Several POS systems, devices and acquirers multiply the certifications one software version needs (Options for Reducing Level). Visa Ready Tap to Phone certification takes 6 to 12 months with lab costs of USD 50,000 or more, by Visa's own account (Tap to Phone). Key exchange fails unless Visa lists the institution as a Dynamic Key Exchange participant (VisaNet Authorization-Only Online Messages). A first subscription to an optional file such as the enhanced TC 33 capture file triggers full implementation activities (Visa Token Service Technical).

Those manuals and bulletins live in the Technical Resource Center on Mastercard Connect, which needs an account set up through a Mastercard representative (Announcements · Mastercard Send Registration · API Basics). Connections run through Mastercard-owned equipment such as the Mastercard Interface Processor (Mastercard Rules). Host validation (NIV) tests the ISO 8583 interface using a licensed Mastercard simulator ordered from the Simulator Suite on Mastercard Connect (EMV Testing and Certification). An implementation project manager builds each session's case list, and the Test Selection Engine builds terminal plans from the configuration (EMV Testing and Certification). Mastercard also serves a public 64-page mapping from an ISO 20022 authorisation response to ISO 8583 data elements (Test Data Mapping cain.002.001.02). File Express is ordered in the Connect Store. The company's Security Administrator approves, then Mastercard, and each user needs a SecurID (File Express Client User). The CIS is reissued with a summary of changes since the last edition. Changes carry release names such as 10.2 or 19.Q2 (Customer Interface Specification · Customer Interface Specification).Mastercard Connect Store. Where customers request applications such as the Technical Resource Center, Simulator Suite and Mastercard Move (Customer Portal · EMV Testing and Certification). Mastercard Test Facility (MTF). A production-like test environment reached through an implementation manager (MTF Access Guide). Support Case Management. The Connect application for technical cases (Release Notes and Dates). File Express Client. Windows application for production and test file exchange, with separate MTF hosts, archive retrieval and a transfer log by endpoint and bulk type (File Express Client User). File Express file profile. Mastercard-held list of the endpoints and bulk types each licensed user may exchange (File Express Client User).Connect sign-in needs a User ID and an RSA SecurID token (Mastercard Connect). M-TIP Self-Approval and Fast Track let enrolled acquirers approve terminals themselves or reuse another acquirer's approval (EMV Testing and Certification). Hosts must process new DE 48 subelements that Mastercard has not announced (Customer Interface Specification).

Merchant and processor specifications such as GCAG sit on the password-protected merchantspecs site, and changes are announced six months ahead in a NOSC (Merchant Regulations International · Notification of Specification Changes · Amex Token Service Guide). Data links had to be redundant, and planned maintenance needed 72 hours' notice (Discover Merchant Operating Regulations).EASI registration form. Best pattern. Discover's own host simulator already shows acquirers results as they test and drops test-log submission, which is the most self-serve certification step found (EMV Testing and Certification). Discover today. What public sources could not show

  1. Visa Online screens for VTS issuer enrolment, host test scripts and VCMS scheduling They sit behind Visa Access and the only public trace of VTS enrolment is a 2014 deck. Ask a friendly issuer or processor for a screen share, or watch Visa University and DPS conference sessions for demos.
  2. Visa's Onboarding Dashboard launched in September 2025 The official videos show the earlier going-live form and may predate it. Register a sandbox account yourself as a Discover employee and walk it, within Visa's terms.
  3. Mastercard Connect Store, Technical Resource Center, Simulator Suite and Access Manager Connect needs an RSA token and a company administrator's approval. Ask an acquirer partner for a walkthrough, or mine Mastercard Academy course outlines.
  4. Amex Knowledge Base, merchantspecs and the AMEX Enabled Dashboard All three are login-only and nothing in the public record shows their screens beyond marketing copy. Interview an OptBlue processor or an AMEX Enabled vendor.
  5. Discover Developer Center signed in, EASI Document Library, Release Compliance Tool and the host simulator UI Every one is behind invitation or login, and this study may not use internal material. Discover's own teams can review them internally and compare them against this benchmark.
  6. PULSE interface specifications and the processor portal No public document, job posting or processor guide describing them was found. Interview a PULSE processor client or a credit union card services manager.
  7. Real elapsed times from sandbox to production Networks publish ranges or none, and partner reports of actual time are rare. Survey processors and developer forums, and track dated forum threads.
  8. How processors split one certification across many clients Processors describe outcomes, not their internal network testing workflow. Interview a processor's network certification lead.

Launch

Amex is the only network whose public rules define a launch gate for issuers. A Beta Test of up to 60 days, a sample card check and a written go-ahead come first (American Express Global Network). Amex also commits to review windows at launch. Final advertising gets an answer in 7 to 10 business days and co-brand partners in 10 business days (American Express Global Network). Visa and Mastercard rules never use the word pilot. Their go-live is a string of approvals and table loads with no single moment that says a partner is live (Visa Core Rules · Mastercard Rules). Mastercard's clearest live signal sits in product onboarding. Mastercard Send ends MTF testing with a TAN letter and asks partners to find their first transactions in reconciliation reports (Mastercard Send Disbursements Onboarding · Mastercard Send Onboarding Checklist). Card design approval is gated everywhere. Visa wants every design before production, Mastercard routes proofs from the manufacturer through CDAS, and both keep the standards behind a login (Visa Core Rules · MasterCard Resource Guide · Mastercard Rules · Mastercard Branding Requirements). Going live for acquirers means loading the network's range tables fast. Visa gives 6 business days and Mastercard 6 calendar days, and Discover needs an NDA for its full table (Visa Core Rules · 8-Digit BIN Migration Toolkit · Global Payment Network IIN). Marks carry published deadlines after launch. PULSE gives issuers 9 and 24 months and ATMs 45 days, Mastercard gives debit issuers 9 and 36 months, and Visa gives ATMs 30 days (PULSE Graphic Standards Manual · Mastercard Rules · Visa Core Rules). Capital One's move of about 25 million debit cards from Mastercard to Discover is the one large conversion with public detail. It began with pilot populations in June 2025 (After Moving Debit Cards · Capital One (COF) Q2 · Capital One 10-K 2025). The conversion's friction landed on cardholders and merchants. New numbers, a 130-day overlap, instant-transfer gaps, travel acceptance warnings and higher debit interchange all appear in public notices (New debit card, same · Changes following Capital One's · Changes to instant transfers · Traveling with debit card · Changes following Capital One’s). Costco's single-day cutover from Amex to Visa in 2016 produced 1.5 million service calls. Walmart's phased 2014 move let old cards work until new ones were active (Costco's transition to Visa). Discover's strongest public launch pattern is human. Discover Debit names an implementation project manager for launch, and its API go-live ends in launch support and monitoring (Discover Debit · Going Live with Discover). Early transaction monitoring after launch is thin in public. Visa's rule for day-31 new-merchant exception reports carries an end date of 17 April 2026 (Visa Core Rules).

Design moves at this stage

5.1A written go-ahead that says you are liveStrong evidence
The move
Make go-live a single network-issued notice. It lists what was certified, the sample card or test result approved, the effective date and the first live transactions seen.
Why it wins
Visa and Mastercard rules define no pilot and no live moment. Amex's go-ahead notice and Mastercard's TAN letter show partners value a formal artefact. Discover's letter already names scope, tools and waivers, so the go-ahead can extend a document partners know. (American Express Global Network · EMV Testing and Certification · Visa Core Rules · Mastercard Rules · UnionPay International Open Platform · D-PAS Terminal End-to-End Letter)
For
Issuers: large banks, Issuers: community banks and credit unions, Fintechs and programme managers, Acquirers and processors
5.2A conversion kit built from the Capital One reissueStrong evidence
The move
Package conversion as a product. Plan pilot waves, set the overlap window, push account updater, warn merchants and payroll providers, and show acceptance where cardholders travel.
Why it wins
Discover is the only network that has just run a large public conversion. The known pain points map to steps a kit can pre-empt. (Capital One (COF) Q2 · Changes following Capital One's · Changes to instant transfers · Traveling with debit card · Costco's transition to Visa)
For
Converting issuers (portfolio conversions and reissues between networks), Issuers: community banks and credit unions, Issuers: large banks
5.3A shared first-weeks launch roomModerate evidence
The move
Open a launch view for the first weeks after go-live. It shows approval rates, declines by reason, disputes and the named implementation lead, then hands over to account management.
Why it wins
Discover already promises launch monitoring and a named implementation manager. Visa's prescriptive new-merchant checks are ending, so a shared early view fills a gap. (Going Live with Discover · Discover Debit · Visa Core Rules · Mastercard Send Onboarding Checklist)
For
Issuers: large banks, Issuers: community banks and credit unions, Acquirers and processors, Payment facilitators and ISOs, Developers
5.4Card art once, used everywhereModerate evidence
The move
Take one card art submission that drives design approval, wallet and token art and Marketing Hub collateral, with status visible to the issuer, processor and card vendor.
Why it wins
Visa and Mastercard route design approval through vendors and gated systems. Token art is a separate duty and wallet updates take days to spread. Processors load wallet art separately in Visa's VCMM and the Mastercard portal, keyed to the manufacturer's reference. (Visa Core Rules · MasterCard Resource Guide · Design a Card · Partner Support Services · Tokenisation Service Guide, Version)
For
Issuers: large banks, Issuers: community banks and credit unions, Fintechs and programme managers
5.5Marks and deadlines inside the launch checklistModerate evidence
The move
Put mark rules, downloads, signage ordering and the post-launch deadlines into the partner's launch checklist, with bulk ordering for acquirers and agents.
Why it wins
PULSE already publishes its manual and deadlines openly. Amex gives agents bulk signage, while Discover's signage site needs a separate login. The 2011 rules tied the contactless mark to device certification, so mark downloads can unlock when certification passes. (PULSE Graphic Standards Manual · American Express Signage Bulk · Discover Signage Site · Visa Core Rules · Discover Merchant Operating Regulations)
For
Issuers: community banks and credit unions, ATM operators, Merchants (acceptance marks and signage), Payment facilitators and ISOs
5.6Show committed review service levelsModerate evidence
The move
Where the network commits to a review time, show it on the task, for example card art, marketing or co-brand review. Leave estimates out.
Why it wins
Amex writes review windows into its policies and Mastercom publishes key approval times. Discover's host review service levels exist but are private. (American Express Global Network · Onboarding Checklist · EMV Testing and Certification)
For
Issuers: large banks, Fintechs and programme managers, Acquirers and processors
5.7Range readiness before cards shipThin evidence
The move
Publish new BIN ranges with effective dates and show issuers which major acquirers have loaded them before cards go out.
Why it wins
Every network sets a table-load deadline. No public source shows a network telling issuers whether acceptance is ready, and Discover's full table needs an NDA. (Visa Core Rules · 8-Digit BIN Migration Toolkit · BIN Ranges · Global Payment Network IIN · Capital One x Discover)
For
Acquirers and processors, Converting issuers (portfolio conversions and reissues between networks)

How it works, by partner type

Issuers: large banks

NetworkHow it worksTools and screensFriction
VisaThe issuer submits every card design, physical or digital, for Visa's written approval before production and again after any change (Visa Core Rules). In Europe the issuer self-certifies each design on a Card Design Member Self-Certification Form (Visa Core Rules). Visa's training describes a four-step approval run through the Brand Management Approval System, which card vendors reach on Visa Online (Payment Device Design Approval). Restricted-use programmes need an approved Program Information Form and a unique account range before launch (Visa Core Rules). Within 10 business days of a BIN going live, the issuer must load its contacts into the Client Directory on Visa Access (Visa Core Rules). The issuer hands Visa its card art for wallets and token requestors, or Visa shows default art (Visa Core Rules). Regional implementation analysts project-manage new product launches and the twice-yearly release cycle (Implementation Analyst). Visa's 10-K says client incentive estimates rest on forecasts of card issuance and card conversion (Visa 10-K 2025). Regions set response time limits, and a request the issuer misses goes to stand-in processing using the issuer's parameters (V.I.P. System Overview).Visa Access (formerly Visa Online). Gated client portal that hosts the Client Directory, BMAS and other launch tools, entered with a Business ID (Visa Core Rules · Log). Client Portfolio Management Self-Service Tools. Program Request Management, the electronic Client Information Questionnaire and the Visa Client Support Application, used to manage profile and programme data (Visa Core Rules). Brand Management Approval System (BMAS). Card design submission and approval cases. Screens were not seen because the public copy of the user guide sits behind a CAPTCHA (Payment Device Design Approval).The rules name no pilot phase and no notice that a programme is live, so the issuer's own directory update is the nearest confirmation (Visa Core Rules). Visa says its design approval gives no legal protection, so issuers still run their own legal review in parallel (Visa Core Rules).
MastercardCard rules live in the Card Design Standards, which sit on Mastercard Connect and are incorporated into the rules (Mastercard Rules · Mastercard Branding Requirements). In the 2011 new-issuer guide, the issuer's certified manufacturer sends a colour proof through CDAS and Card Design Management approves it before manufacture (MasterCard Resource Guide). Each co-brand, prepaid or virtual product was registered on a Special Issuer Registration Form in that guide. Prepaid now uses a registration tool on Mastercard Connect (MasterCard Resource Guide · Mastercard Rules). Billing and settlement start the moment the ICA is assigned, before any card is live (MasterCard Resource Guide). In 2011 each new institution had to register for a list of mandatory online products, and service provider registration took about 5 to 7 business days (MasterCard Resource Guide). Mastercard asks issuers to put new programmes on unused account ranges of existing BINs before requesting new ones (8-Digit BIN Migration Toolkit). A new debit issuer has nine months to start issuing compliant cards and 36 months to bring the whole portfolio into line (Mastercard Rules).Mastercard Connect. Gated portal holding Card Design Standards, My Company Manager and registration applications (Mastercard Rules). Card Design Approvals System (CDAS). Manufacturer-side proof submission for card design approval, as described in 2011 (MasterCard Resource Guide). Mastercard Brand Center. Public logo artwork, branding requirements and decal ordering, which sends issuers to Connect for card artwork (Mastercard Brand Center · Mastercard Branding Requirements).The only public walk-through of issuer launch is a 2011 guide, so current screens and turnaround times cannot be confirmed (MasterCard Resource Guide). The 2011 guide pitched itself to issuers converting a portfolio, yet no later public version has been found (MasterCard Resource Guide). The rules contain no pilot or soft-launch concept (Mastercard Rules).
American ExpressBefore launch Amex explains the specifications, certifies the issuer, assigns settlement parameters and number ranges and works with its marketing agency (American Express Global Network). Issuers certify host messaging and each payment product with Amex teams, test simulators and custom test plans (American Express Certification). Amex and the issuer run a Beta Test of up to 60 days before any sales for each card type or design change (American Express Global Network). After the Beta Test and a sample card check, Amex tells the issuer in writing that it may start selling (American Express Global Network). The issuer should launch within 45 days of the Beta Test ending (American Express Global Network). Mass-media launch campaigns go to Amex 30 days ahead, and the final review comes back in 7 to 10 business days (American Express Global Network). Co-brand partners go to Amex at least 60 business days before launch, with an answer in 10 business days (American Express Global Network). From launch the issuer files monthly Program Progress Reports within 15 days of month-end (American Express Global Network).Knowledge Base. Gated library of Network Specifications, card design guidelines and the Issuer Personalization Certification Guide (American Express Certification). FraudNet, Network Disputes Manager, Program Progress Report. Operational systems a partner's staff can open only after finishing training (American Express Global Network). Partner Learning. Webinars and six modules covering over fifty network policies (Partner Learning).Amex-led personalisation certification costs 15,000 dollars per certification, charged to the issuer (American Express Global Network). Every design change reopens the Beta Test, which slows card refreshes (American Express Global Network).
Discover familyCapital One is the one large issuer launched onto the network in public view, and it is the network's owner (Capital One 10-K 2025). Discover publishes no application steps, timelines or fees for new issuing partners (How We Partner). Capital One lists limited third-party card issuance on its networks as a risk (Capital One 10-K 2025). For Diners Club issuers, Discover promises extensive implementation support and turnkey marketing programmes (Diners Club International Issuing).Discover Service Center login. One MFA login for fraud tools and client portals, with EASI and dispute portals listed alongside (Fraud and Risk Center).No public document shows how Discover approves card designs for Discover or Diners Club issuers (Card Production Vendor Compliance).

Best pattern. Amex's written sequence of certification, a capped Beta Test, a sample card check and a go-ahead notice gives both sides one shared definition of launched (American Express Global Network). Discover today. Discover shows no public issuer launch path beyond its owner's conversion. Third-party issuance is a stated risk and application steps are unpublished (How We Partner · Capital One 10-K 2025).

MastercardAcquirers and anyone holding BIN files for them must apply each Mastercard update within 6 calendar days (8-Digit BIN Migration Toolkit). The Member Parameter Extract arrives by Global File Transfer with daily add, change and delete updates (8-Digit BIN Migration Toolkit). Host validation ends in a TAN letter, and enrolled acquirers can self-approve terminals or reuse another acquirer's approval (EMV Testing and Certification). In the EEA and UK, routing tables must be filed at least five business days before going live (Mastercard Switch Rules).Member Parameter Extract (MPE). Daily BIN and account range table updates for issuers, acquirers and processors (8-Digit BIN Migration Toolkit). Testing Acknowledgement Notification (TAN) letter. Record of a completed validation session, used as the go-ahead for production (EMV Testing and Certification).Stale tables cause wrong routing and declines, and Mastercard puts the fix on the acquirer (8-Digit BIN Migration Toolkit).

To certify a POS device, the acquirer sends a request form, interaction logs and receipts to its relationship manager and runs the cases it receives (American Express Certification). Each capability path on the certification page ends with the product being AMEX Enabled (American Express Certification).Knowledge Base. Network Specifications and implementation guides needed for host certification (American Express Certification).Test cases arrive from a relationship manager, so the path depends on one named contact (American Express Certification).
Discover familyAcquirers register for the EASI portal to get specifications, test card kits and a Message Center to operations (Payments Providers). The EASI form asks the company type and the NDA signatory, then emails login credentials (EASI Portal). The public BIN file shows only start, end and length. The full table with product detail sits in EASI under NDA (Global Payment Network IIN). Accepting alliance cards and Discover Debit depends on the acquirer loading every Discover range (BIN Ranges). Discover's Letter of Certification is the go-ahead for a terminal set. It records scope, terminal, software, test plan versions and any waivers (D-PAS Terminal End-to-End Letter).EASI Portal registration. Discover host test simulator. Lets acquirers test at any time and see results immediately (EMV Testing and Certification).Discover reviews host results within service levels agreed privately, so no public commitment exists (EMV Testing and Certification).

Best pattern. Mastercard pairs a firm table-update deadline with a named TAN letter and lets proven acquirers self-approve terminals (8-Digit BIN Migration Toolkit · EMV Testing and Certification). Discover today. Discover offers EASI, a live test simulator and self-certification, but range data needs an NDA and review service levels are private (Payments Providers · EMV Testing and Certification · Global Payment Network IIN).
