Converting issuers (portfolio conversions and reissues between networks)

NetworkHow it worksTools and screensFriction
Discover familyCapital One told regulators it would move all debit and a meaningful share of credit to its networks by 2027 (Conditional Approval Letter · Federal Reserve order 2025-10). Reissue began with pilot populations in June 2025 and ran in phases into early 2026 (Capital One (COF) Q2). Cards went out account by account. Account number and PIN stayed the same, while card number, code and expiry changed (Your new Capital One · New debit card, same). Activating the new card turned off the old one, and old cards kept working for 130 days if not activated (Your new Capital One · Changes following Capital One's). By February 2026 the reissue was substantially complete, and trade press counted about 25 million cards (Capital One 10-K 2025 · After Moving Debit Cards). Stripe told merchants the debit migration would finish in 2026 (Changes following Capital One's). Credit is next. Capital One is testing conversions and planned waves in July, October and January (Capital One Tests Moving · After Moving Debit Cards).Capital One 'My debit card' page. Cardholder view of the switch: new card, activation, recurring payments, network changes and FAQs (Your new Capital One). Stripe service notice. Merchant view: account updater fees, higher interchange, 130-day overlap and country coverage (Changes following Capital One's).Mastercard network benefits ended on activation, and some payroll and earned-wage providers dropped instant transfers (Your new Capital One · Changes to instant transfers). Travellers were told to plan for acceptance and cash abroad, and Stripe warned of declines outside Discover coverage (Traveling with debit card · Changes following Capital One's). Merchants saw new Discover BINs with Discover as issuer and uncapped debit rates they cannot avoid (Capital One x Discover · Changes following Capital One’s · Capital One’s Discover Merger). Venture X and several co-brands stayed on Visa, so one bank now runs two networks for its customers (After Moving Debit Cards).
VisaCostco's Amex cards stopped for new purchases on one day in June 2016 when Citi's Visa cards replaced them (Costco's transition to Visa). Credit union flips to Visa follow processor changes and use Visa Account Updater (Our New Visa Debit · Debit Card Update). Visa prices conversion into client incentives (Visa 10-K 2025).None found in publicCiti logged over 1.5 million calls about cards not arriving, activation and online access (Costco's transition to Visa). DOJ alleges reissue cost keeps issuers from switching. This is an allegation (United States v. Visa).
MastercardWalmart's 2014 move from Discover to Mastercard ran in phases, with old cards working until new ones were active (Costco's transition to Visa). Mastercard's 2011 resource guide was written for issuers growing or converting a portfolio (MasterCard Resource Guide).None found in publicA new debit portfolio has 36 months to meet card standards, which sets the pace of a reissue (Mastercard Rules).
Issuer processors and token vendorsProcessors sell migration as a service covering regulation, network engagement, inventory and cardholder communication (Simplifying the process). Token vendors pitch keeping stored credentials alive when network identifiers change (Capital One Migration).None found in publicReissuing a whole BIN range at once breaks stored credentials (Card Credential Lifecycle).

Best pattern. A phased reissue with pilot groups and an overlap window, as Walmart and Capital One ran, avoids the one-day cutover that swamped Citi (Costco's transition to Visa · Capital One (COF) Q2 · Changes following Capital One's). Discover today. Discover has just absorbed the largest recent debit conversion. Its public record shows cardholder and merchant notices but no network-side conversion kit for other issuers (Capital One 10-K 2025 · Your new Capital One · Changes following Capital One's).

What public sources could not show

  1. Visa BMAS screens for card design submission and approval The only public user guide copy found sits on Slideshare behind a CAPTCHA, which this study does not bypass. Ask a card vendor or issuer partner for a screen walk, or find a card bureau's published BMAS guide.
  2. Mastercard Card Design Standards and current CDAS workflow Both sit on Mastercard Connect, and the only public description is a 2011 guide. Review an issuer or card bureau's copy under NDA, or a recent Mastercard issuer welcome kit.
  3. How Discover and Diners Club approve issuer card designs No public document describes it. Only card vendor compliance rules are public. Ask the Discover issuing team for the internal card design approval steps and turnaround.
  4. Network-side early monitoring of newly launched issuers and acquirers No network publishes a first-weeks monitoring view, and Visa's new-merchant rules are sunsetting. Interview implementation and account managers at processors about what they watch after go-live.
  5. Merchant and acquirer communications Discover sent during the Capital One debit move Only processor and consultancy notices are public, not Discover's own bulletins. Look for acquirer bulletins in the EASI Message Center or ask acquirer partners.
  6. Visa merchant signage ordering No public Visa signage order site was located, and the web search budget ran out before a wider search. Search Visa merchant resources pages or ask an acquirer how its merchants get Visa decals.
  7. ATM operator go-live with each network Independent operators launch through processors and sponsors, and networks publish no operator path. Interview an ATM processor about network set-up steps, terminal IDs and signage deadlines.
  8. PULSE Operating Rules in full Only the rule excerpts quoted in the Graphic Standards Manual are public. Request the rules from PULSE or read them through a participating issuer.
  9. Mastercard Connect implementation tracking screens Customer Implementation Services and Delivery Manager tools are gated. Look for processor or bank training material that shows implementation status screens.

Run: money

On every network studied, money runs on daily files and reports that the partner must reconcile itself. Visa issues VSS reports, Mastercard six GCMS cycles and Amex one Daily Activity Report (Settlement Operations Support Self-Service · Settlement and Reconciliation · Global Clearing Management System · Business and Operational Policies). Settlement and billing are separate streams. Mastercard bills weekly through MCBS, Visa invoices through its Online Invoice Portal, and both collect fees by ACH in the US (Mastercard Pricing & Fees · Best Practices · Visa Core Rules). The UK regulator found issuers generally cope with Mastercard and Visa fee information. Acquirers do not, so the pain concentrates on the acquiring side (Market review of card · MR22/1.10 Market review). The weakest link is tying an invoice line to the transactions that triggered it. Portal bulletin codes do not match invoice codes, and some Visa bulletins omitted the billing event (Market review of card · MR22/1.10 Market review). Visa and Mastercard each told the UK regulator they could not supply that fee logic within a year. Mastercard cited many billing events and poorly documented legacy systems (Decision on requests · PS26/1 Market review). Regulators are now setting a floor. UK rules require a unique billing identifier and fee logic from July 2027, and the RBA expects machine-readable invoices at no extra cost (Specific Direction 22 · PS26/1: Market review · Scheme Fees, Conclusions Paper). Interchange downgrades are found after the fact, in processor reports. Mastercard's parameter file lists rate designators but omits the rates, so acquirers cannot compute expected interchange from it (Settlement Operations Support Self-Service · Global Clearing Management System). American Express is the clearest public counterexample. Its GNS manual publishes settlement timing, fee amounts and two-way late compensation, and its merchant files state the net payment arithmetic (Business and Operational Policies · Finance::AMEX::Transaction::GRRCN::Summary · Finance::AMEX::Transaction::GRRCN::TxnPricing). Processors and programme managers fill the gap. Stripe and Lithic turn raw network files into settlement records with states, and vendors sell invoice analysis to acquirers and issuers (Issuing settlements · Settlement API · Solutions for Merchant Acquirers · Network Fee Tracking). The Discover family is split. PULSE sells a one-page invoice and single-point gateway settlement, while Discover keeps US acquirer rates confidential and misclassified cards for sixteen years without telling merchants (Discover Debit · PULSE Gateway Services · U.S. Acquirer Interchange Pricing · Order to Cease). The public record is thin on current settlement manuals, invoice layouts and analytics screens for all four networks. Most detail comes from processor republications and regulator files (Settlement and Reconciliation · Mastercard Pricing & Fees · Financial Reconciliation and Automation · U.S. Acquirer Interchange Pricing).

Design moves at this stage

6a.1Every fee line traces to its triggerStrong evidence
The move
Give each invoice line a stable billing identifier, a plain description, its trigger rule and a link to the transactions behind it. Make it downloadable as data at no charge.
Why it wins
Visa and Mastercard told the UK regulator they cannot supply this within a year. Portal codes that differ from invoice codes are a documented acquirer complaint. Mastercard's SWCHD586-A already groups debit fees by message type and function code, with a net fees page for each processor. (Specific Direction 22 · Decision on requests · PS26/1 Market review · Market review of card · Scheme Fees, Conclusions Paper · MDS Settlement and Reports)
For
Acquirers and processors, Payment facilitators and ISOs, Issuers
6a.2Show the class and rate each transaction was billed atStrong evidence
The move
Per transaction, show the card class, the interchange programme priced and cleared, and the reason for any downgrade, kept for the retention period.
Why it wins
The Fed found Discover charged a commercial rate for sixteen years without telling merchants. Cybersource already shows priced against cleared with a reason code. OptBlue puts most fees in the GRRCN file, while the rate table stays in an appendix Participants may not publish. Visa's SMS detail reports can print each transaction's fee level and jurisdiction, yet that line is off by default and changed only through a representative. (Order to Cease · Fee Details Report · Settlement Operations Support Self-Service · Global Clearing Management System · OptBlue Program Operating Regulations · VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS))
For
Acquirers and processors, Payment facilitators and ISOs, Merchants where they touch the network directly
6a.3Totals that tie to the wireStrong evidence
The move
State the settlement arithmetic on screen and guarantee that report totals equal the funds moved, with the tie-out shown for each day.
Why it wins
Issuers rebuild Mastercard fund reconciliation from fragments. Amex, Mastercard Send and Discover's own old report show the tie-out can be promised. Mastercard's Transfer Agent Advisement Detail shows one section per member ID within one payment, a working model for tying ledgers to a single wire. Mastercard's 2006 switch manual says SWCHD363 amounts should match the settlement records, and urges processors to automate the daily compare. (How issuer banks can · Reconciliation Reports · Finance::AMEX::Transaction::GRRCN::Summary · Daily Activity Report Sample · Mastercard Settlement Manual · MDS Settlement and Reports)
For
Issuers, Acquirers and processors, Fintechs and programme managers
6a.4Change notice names the billing lineStrong evidence
The move
Announce each fee change six months ahead with the billing identifier it will appear under, and offer an impact estimate on the partner's own past volume.
Why it wins
Visa bulletins omitted billing events, so fees appeared first on invoices. UK rules now require six months' notice and on-request impact models. OptBlue already commits to 180 days' written notice before wholesale fees change, a lead time a network could publish per fee line. (Market review of card · Stakeholder submissions to MR22/1.6 · Specific Direction 22 · Review of Retail Payments · OptBlue Program Operating Regulations)
For
Acquirers and processors, Issuers, Payment facilitators and ISOs
6a.5Settlement day as a statusModerate evidence
The move
Show each settlement day as pending or complete, with each file's delivery state and a proactive notice when a network file is late. Show committed service levels only.
Why it wins
Late network files are the main cause of processor delays, and Mastercard makes senders phone to confirm a file. Stripe and Lithic already treat completeness as a state. Mastercard already emails opt-in open settlement notices, yet a missed notice does not stop daily assessments from USD 250. Visa's single message system already keeps 30-minute running totals as 0520 advices, a working base for an intraday settlement status. (Settlement API · Settlement API · Issuing settlements · Global Clearing Management System · Reconciliation Reports · Mastercard Settlement Manual · VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS))
For
Issuers, Fintechs and programme managers, Acquirers and processors
6a.6Fix billing errors for everyoneModerate evidence
The move
When the network finds a billing error, correct it for every affected partner, show the correction beside the original line and say when it will settle.
Why it wins
The RBA expects this. Mastercard sought to claw back years of fees after its own error, and Discover's refunds are still being allocated years later. (Review of Retail Payments · MR22/1.10 Annex 12 · Discover Card Merchant Class · Discover 10-K 2024 · Scheme Fees, Review)
For
Acquirers and processors, Issuers, Merchants where they touch the network directly
6a.7Keep the short billModerate evidence
The move
Carry the one-page invoice and single-point gateway settlement into the portal as the default view, with one line per network and detail on demand.
Why it wins
Community banks and credit unions complain of long, error-prone bills and thin teams. (Discover Debit · PULSE Gateway Services · Comment on Docket OCC-2025-0537 · Request for Information Regarding · Card Services Manager)
For
Issuers, ATM operators
6a.8Publish the money rulebookModerate evidence
The move
Publish one public page of settlement timing, exception handling, fee amounts and standard acquirer and ATM rates, with dated future changes. Publishing US rates is a business decision.
Why it wins
Amex GNS and Interac already publish this. Discover keeps US acquirer rates behind a code, and PULSE gives no ATM amounts. Visa's VSS guide and Mastercard's Settlement Manual are marked confidential or proprietary, yet 2018 and 2020 copies are openly readable on a document-sharing site. (Business and Operational Policies · Understanding Fees · U.S. Acquirer Interchange Pricing · Standard Acquirer Rates · ATM Acquirers · VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS) · Mastercard Settlement Manual)
For
Acquirers and processors, Issuers, ATM operators
6a.9The same data as file and APIModerate evidence
The move
Offer settlement, invoice and interchange data both as files and as an API with completeness flags, so processors stop rebuilding it for each client.
Why it wins
Mastercard's public catalogue has no settlement or billing API, and Adyen's delayed-fee report has none. Programme managers each build their own wrapper. Mastercard sends the same advisement by Connect, email, fax or SWIFT MT998, and Visa offers every VSS report as TC 46 data or TC 47 print. Visa lets SMS members take the same activity as formatted reports or as 130-byte raw data records. (Mastercard Developers llms.txt catalogue · Connector Improvement · Settlement API · Settlement and Reconciliation · Card Interchange Activity Report · Mastercard Settlement Manual · VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS) · VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS))
For
Fintechs and programme managers, Developers, Acquirers and processors
6a.10An ATM statement by terminal and networkThin evidence
The move
Give operators and their processors a per-terminal view of interchange by network, net of network fees, with each fee named and its rate shown.
Why it wins
Operators say networks set interchange and fees pass through unevenly. Many reconcile in spreadsheets, and the study found no network offering operators this view directly. (NCR Atleos 10-K 2025 · Cardtronics USA v. Visa · How to Read · What's an ATM's total · Daily and Monthly Reports)
For
ATM operators

How it works, by partner type

Issuers (large banks, community banks, credit unions)

NetworkHow it worksTools and screensFriction
VisaVisa settles once a day per settlement service. Marqeta gives the default cut-off as 10:00 GMT in summer and 11:00 GMT in winter (Settlement and Reconciliation · Settlement API). Clearing that arrives after cut-off is reported under a different settlement service heading, which a reconciler must know to match totals (Settlement and Reconciliation). Money moves through a hierarchy of Settlement Reporting Entities. Clients must choose which level's network totals match their own institution setup (How Visa Settlement Works · Settlement API). Visa says most US dollar settlements complete the same day. It indemnifies members against another member's failure to settle and may require collateral (Visa 10-K 2025). Associate members hold their own licence but rely on a Principal for settlement, reporting and fee payment (Visa's Licensing Program). Fees are invoiced separately and collected by ACH under a signed authorisation. In the US Region, member fee collections move as transaction codes 10 and 20, within 45 calendar days for domestic transactions (Visa Core Rules). At a small credit union one manager can own daily card processing, settlement and general ledger reconciliation together (Card Services Manager). Processors re-present the money in their own report codes. FIS report SD-056 nets interchange income against network fees by BIN-level product each day (Daily and Monthly Reports). A member sets up each funds transfer point on paper Settlement Funds Transfer forms. Visa processes complete forms in about 30 days (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). The settlement account must be open, funded and able to take Visa drawdowns before settlement starts. Visa moves no money for positions under USD 1 (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). A new settlement bank, account, currency or post-merger name needs a fresh set of forms. ABA or SWIFT changes go by signed letter on letterhead (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). Non-dollar settlement pays two currency business days after processing. Visa's settlement bank sends the SWIFT debit request two days before value date (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). A national settlement service may set a domestic cut-off between 01:00 and 10:00 GMT. Every member in that country must agree the time (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). Members in those countries then receive two report sets a day. National reports arrive about an hour after the national cut-off (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). A trial balance service gives settlement agents interim reports from an earlier cut-off, before the final international run (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). VSS reports run seven days a week. Monthly fees and charges are calculated daily and held until the last calendar day of the month (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). Visa asks three months' notice for a first VSS set-up and two months for a new funds transfer. Choices are recorded on paper worksheets (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). Single Message System members can take an 0620 funds transfer totals message when settlement completes. First-time recipients certify over two days (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)).VSS-110 Settlement Summary. Daily totals for interchange value, reimbursement fees and Visa charges, split by issuer, acquirer and other business modes, with a monthly VSS-110-M (Issuing settlements · Settlement and Reconciliation). VSS report family (VSS-110, 115, 120, 130, 140). Settlement summary, entity recaps, interchange value, reimbursement fees and Visa charges, delivered as machine-readable TC46 and print-ready TC47 files (Settlement Operations Support Self-Service · Settlement and Reconciliation). Visa Online Invoice Portal (VOIP). Invoices under Global Member Billing Solutions, with Invoice & Collection Summary, Collection Details, and Current Billing Summary and Detail sections (Best Practices · Best Practices). VisaVue Online. Benchmarks plus authorisation, fraud, fee and exception data, holding 25 months of portfolio data and 13 months of transaction data (VisaVue Online). VSS report subscription. Each SRE picks its own reports. Only VSS-110 is mandatory, for funds transfer points, and optional reports appear only when subscribed (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). VSS-110 print layout. Header names the reporting SRE, its roll-up SRE and the funds transfer entity. A funds transfer amount shows only for a funds transfer SRE (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). VSS-100-W and VSS-100-R hierarchy lists. The settlement hierarchy under each SRE, with YES in a Funds Transfer column. Delivered on Thursdays and Sundays (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). VSS-300, VSS-135, VSS-610, VSS-640 and VSS-950. Financial recap per subordinate SRE, month-to-date reimbursement fees, pending fees and charges before month end, and a no-data notice for quiet subscribed reports (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). Customised hierarchy checklist. An implementation checklist requiring, among other rules, a unique 15-character name for every SRE in a custom hierarchy (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). SMS600 to SMS617 transaction and exception detail reports. Daily lists of single message transactions, chargebacks, representments, adjustments and reversals. Each can be sorted by card, retrieval reference, time or counterparty ID (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). SMS642 and SMS643 CRS Returned Exception Detail. Exception items returned unsettled after failing Chargeback Reduction Service checks, with up to five return reason codes, ready to correct and resubmit (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). SMS660 No Activity Report. Each subscribed SMS report that had nothing to show in the cycle, so a missing report reads as no activity (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). SMS detail report fee line. Fee jurisdiction, routing, fee level name and fee programme indicator for each transaction, all supplied by Visa on optional line 5 (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)).Reading a Visa invoice needs knowledge of settlement and collection entities, which Visa teaches as a course (Best Practices). Settlement reporting and reconciliation are sold as paid training webcasts (Visa Settlement Reports). Report selection is not self-serve for programmes behind a processor. Marqeta tells customers to ask their Visa representative which VSS reports they can receive (Settlement and Reconciliation). Visa's rules make every US issuer pay Advanced Authorization fees whether or not it uses the data (Visa Core Rules). Settlement set-up and bank changes run on paper forms, letters and worksheets with lead times of weeks to months (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). The interchange fee line on SMS detail reports is off by default. Changing report lines means contacting a Visa Member Services representative (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)).
MastercardClearing reaches issuers in six GCMS cycles a day, cut off in St. Louis time. Every customer must take data from all six (Global Clearing Management System). Mastercard settles most customers Monday to Friday after the sixth cycle. Monday advisements carry Saturday, Sunday and Monday totals (Global Clearing Management System). In the US the settlement agent pulls funds by Fedwire drawdown, which a BaaS guide times at 8:00 Central (Mastercard Pricing & Fees). A new issuer signs a Net Settlement Agreement and must fund settlement and billing from the day its ICA is assigned, or face assessments (MasterCard Resource Guide). MCBS bills weekly to each ICA and covers Mastercard, Cirrus and Maestro fees. US banks authorise ACH drafts for it (Mastercard Pricing & Fees · Billing Analyst-1). Issuers tie out in layers, from dispute rows to the per-cycle position to PDS 0396, the net amount in the day's wire (How issuer banks can). Processors re-present the bill. FIS report BIMCBSM001 lists Mastercard fees by service and event code with quantity, rate and amount to reconcile the monthly bill (Daily and Monthly Reports). A principal joins settlement by filing the online Net Settlement Information Form in Mastercard Connect, under Support, Forms, Clearing & Settlement (Mastercard Settlement Manual). Mastercard wants the form 30 days before launch and needs ten business days to review, test and implement the parameters (Mastercard Settlement Manual). US dollar settlement cuts off at 08:00 St. Louis time, and funds owed are due by 14:00 the same day (Mastercard Settlement Manual). Funds transfers usually reach the settlement agent two to three hours after cut-off (Mastercard Settlement Manual). Positions under USD 1,000 can be held for up to ten business days. Some services opt in on Form 829, and others opt out on Form 814 (Mastercard Settlement Manual). Principals must pay the exact advised amount, one payment per ICA and value date (Mastercard Settlement Manual). A disputed advisement must be raised in writing within one business day. The advised amount must still be paid on time (Mastercard Settlement Manual). Missed settlement draws a daily assessment from the first day, from USD 250 up to USD 10,000 by amount (Mastercard Settlement Manual).Pricing and Billing Resource Center (Mastercard Connect). Pricing Guide, Transaction Detail and a Billing Analytic Tool. Requested from the Connect Store and approved by the customer's Security Admin (Mastercard Pricing & Fees). Operational Reports (Mastercard Connect). Invoices and further billing and pricing detail, recommended to sponsor banks by a BaaS provider (Mastercard Pricing & Fees). GCMS cycle reports IP727010-AA, IP727020-AA, IP728010-AA. Per-cycle acknowledgement, notification and summary reports, delivered as bulk type T140 (Global Clearing Management System). Mastercom eStats and T5G2 reconciliation. Case fees totalled by billing event, and dispute clearing events for reconciliation (Mastercom User Guide · How issuer banks can). Transfer Agent Advisement Detail (BSADV308-AA). Daily net position for the transfer agent bank, one section per member ID. Sent by Connect, email, fax or SWIFT MT998 (Mastercard Settlement Manual). Member Advisement Detail (BSADV303-AA). A reconciliation copy for members in a consolidated arrangement. It is not a payment instruction (Mastercard Settlement Manual). Transfer Agent Advisement Exception Report (BSADV309-AA). Payments held under the minimum threshold, with dates, amounts and cumulative value (Mastercard Settlement Manual). NSIF online form and NSIF Super User role. Current settlement parameters on view. The role is ordered in the Connect Store and approved by the customer's Security Administrator (Mastercard Settlement Manual). Open Settlement Invoices email. An opt-in courtesy email about open or outstanding settlement positions and unapplied funds (Mastercard Settlement Manual). SWCHD412 Daily Interchange Report and SWCHM412 monthly. Interchange by product and fee line, with counts split into financial, percentage-based, non-financial and non-billable. A Net Interchange Summary page closes it (MDS Settlement and Reports).Reports are themselves billed, each carrying a billing event. Recreating expired clearing data costs a per-file fee under event 2GC0001 (Mastercard Pricing & Fees · Global Clearing Management System). Mastercard Academy sells a two-day clearing, settlement and billing reconciliation workshop (Course Name). A dispute software vendor says issuers rebuild Mastercard fund reconciliation from documentation fragments and spreadsheets (How issuer banks can). Changing clearing cutoffs goes through the Form 600 worksheet, and on release days early cycle files arrive one to three hours late (Global Clearing Management System). Sponsor banks learn MCBS service codes, such as AB for issuer authorisation, from BaaS guides (Mastercard Pricing & Fees). Missing a courtesy notice does not excuse non-compliance fees (Mastercard Settlement Manual). Held credit funds are released only on a written request carrying an original signature from the principal (Mastercard Settlement Manual). Settlement services are themselves billed monthly. In 2006 Mastercard even billed principal members for the debit settlement manual (Mastercard Settlement Manual · MDS Settlement and Reports). Mastercard Academy sold a two-day MCBS billing seminar for USD 900, invoiced through MCBS under its own billing event (Course: MasterCard Consolidated Billing).
American ExpressGNS runs one net settlement a day with each issuer and acquirer partner, reported on a mandatory Daily Activity Report (Business and Operational Policies). Under Automated Funds Exchange a partner pays its net position the day the report arrives (Business and Operational Policies). Monthly network fees sit in the report's Fee Detail Section by billing unit code and settle on the 26th (Business and Operational Policies). A partner must pay the full reported amount even while disputing it. Late settlement in either direction earns compensation at a published cost-of-funds formula (Business and Operational Policies). The manual publishes fee amounts, including $500 per late settlement, $175 a month per active BIN and $250 a month for portfolio reporting (Business and Operational Policies).Daily Activity Report and Daily Activity File. The report is the consolidated reconciliation record. The optional file feeds a partner's own reconciliation and reporting systems (Business and Operational Policies). Knowledge Base: Reporting Center, File Tracker, Program Progress Reports. Partner applications for reports, file status, monthly programme returns, disputes and fraud (Business and Operational Policies).GNS partners must file monthly Program Progress Reports within 15 days of month end, with an annual attestation (Business and Operational Policies). Settlement delays are notified by phone or fax and confirmed by certified mail (Business and Operational Policies). GNS may withhold a partner's daily net settlement where it judges the financial or brand risk material (Business and Operational Policies).
Discover familyDiscover Debit is sold to community banks and credit unions on an all-in programme fee, a one-page invoice and no quarterly reporting (Discover Debit). A PULSE case study describes the all-in fee as the network fee on portfolio volume, with a two basis point discount for ABA members (Colony Bank Discover Debit). FIS client banks see PULSE fees in a monthly PIN fee report that points them to the PULSE Issuer Fee Schedule for definitions (Daily and Monthly Reports). Diners Club cross-border transactions route and settle through a central service centre, and licensees hold primary liability to pay their own merchants (Discover 10-K 2024).PULSE Debit Dashboard. Cross-networkSTAR tells issuers it settles interchange daily and adds quarterly business reports by merchant category with gross interchange and fees (STAR issuer brochure · STAR issuer brochure 01/23). SHAZAM markets real-time settlement on its single-message pathway and the lowest issuer switch fee, without publishing amounts (Payments Network).FIS iQ Reports tab. Coded daily and monthly settlement reports for banks and credit unions, kept for 90 days and searched in 60-day windows (Daily and Monthly Reports).ICBA told the Fed that most community banks struggled to get network and processing fee data from their technology providers. This is advocacy (ICBA Comments in Response). ICBA says technology providers' billing statements are long and hard to interpret, and many banks retain billing consultants (Comment on Docket OCC-2025-0537). Commenters told the OCC that core providers' bills are confusing and repeatedly wrong (Request for Information Regarding). Vendors say issuers and acquirers mostly track network fees from raw invoices, processor summaries and spreadsheets (Card Network (Scheme) Fee). An FIS posting for a scheme fee analyst describes recalculating fees from five schemes, Diners Club and Discover among them, and reconciling them to invoices (Senior Scheme Fee Analyst).

Best pattern. Amex GNS puts settlement timing, exception handling, two-way late compensation and exact fee amounts in one public manual, so an issuer can predict its monthly bill (Business and Operational Policies). Discover today. PULSE issuers get a one-page all-in invoice and a Debit Dashboard led by gross interchange. Settlement mechanics and fee schedules sit on the client site and appear publicly only through processor reports (Discover Debit · PULSE Debit Dashboard User · Daily and Monthly Reports).

Acquirers and processors

NetworkHow it worksTools and screensFriction
VisaVisa assigns a Fee Program Indicator that places each transaction in an interchange programme. Transactions failing fee edits fall to Standard or named downgrade programmes (October 2023 Interchange Modifications · Visa USA Interchange Reimbursement). Processors pre-qualify transactions before clearing. A Visa downgrade happens when Visa disagrees and reclassifies the transaction to a worse rate (Settlement Operations Support Self-Service). For settlement out-of-balance cases TSYS asks clients for VSS-110, 115, 120, 130 and 140 and tells them to register on each network portal, including Visa Online (Settlement Operations Support Self-Service). Interchange disputes between members run through IRF Compliance. One case can hold up to a million transactions, and Visa's decisions are final with narrow appeal (Visa Core Rules). Visa told the UK regulator that acquirers can reconcile using monthly invoices, an Acquirer Billing Guide launched in 2025 and Visa Client Services (PS26/1 Final decision · PS26/1 Market review). Processors can have each member's BIN stamped into VSS report records, so they can split the reports and pass them to client banks (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). Reports reach BASE II members through the Edit Package, which prints them. Direct Access Service users receive file types such as SETLR (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). SMS611 shows an acquirer each chargeback received, and Visa says it is used to decide whether to accept or represent (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). Instead of reports, SMS members can take 130-byte raw data records. A settlement record per affiliate BIN carries the interchange total (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)).Visa Access. SMS609 Transactions Incurring a Fine. Late adjustments, late deposit adjustments and chargebacks left unrepresented that drew a fine in the processing day (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). Downgrade and reject reports missing from a daily package cannot be recreated later. TSYS gives qualification problems a seven business day target (Settlement Operations Support Self-Service). Processors settling by ACH give their bank, routing number and settlement account on a Processor Information Questionnaire during sign-up (MDS Settlement and Reports). A 2006 release added a BIN field to the daily control and interchange reports, so processors could sort settlement data by BIN (MDS Settlement and Reports).IPM early reconciliation file (T113). Settlement position and errors for each file as soon as it is processed, before the next cycle cutoff (Global Clearing Management System). Clearing Optimizer. Software run on the customer's own hardware that applies GCMS edits before files are sent (Global Clearing Management System). Mastercard Connect billing tools. Consolidated billing in near real time and free behavioural fee reports, as Mastercard described them to the UK regulator (MR22/1.10 Market review · MR22/1.10 Annex 12). Mastercard File Express Client and Scheduler. Upload and download of production and test files, 30 days of archive retrieval, and a daily transfer log by result and endpoint (Version 1.1). Mastercard Data Exchange. Browser file exchange with an Endpoint Summary Page of bulk file types. Users pick the endpoint by hand for each file (Version 1.1). SWCHD363 Daily Control Report and SWCHM363 monthly. Net settlement position in the settlement currency, by transaction type within product. A Net Settlement Summary page nets transactions, exception items and interchange fees (MDS Settlement and Reports). SWCHD586-A Debit Mastercard Inbound/Outbound Fee Report. Retrieval, record clearing, handling and compliance fees sent and received, grouped by message type and function code, with a net fees page per processor (MDS Settlement and Reports).The parameter file acquirers receive lists rate designators but omits the rates, which Mastercard treats as proprietary (Global Clearing Management System). Mastercard stopped phoning acquirers about risk rejects, and a sender with no confirmation file must phone to learn whether its file was processed (Global Clearing Management System). One acquirer said fee code answers from Mastercard and Visa take four to five weeks (MR22/1.10 Market review). One acquirer had eight Mastercard fee trigger misalignments in two years. Another reported Mastercard seeking to claw back several years of fees after its own error (MR22/1.10 Market review · MR22/1.10 Annex 12). Mastercard's reporting schedule pushes one behavioural fee two months behind the transactions at Adyen (What are Non-Transactional scheme). File Express takes two to three weeks to implement. Mastercard warns that leaving file naming until network work ends causes delay (Version 1.1). A second SFTP session on the same user ID makes the first fail, and Mastercard gives no support for third-party SFTP software (Version 1.1). Mastercard warns that SWCHD412 interchange lines cannot be checked line by line where fees are percentage-based or acquirer generated (MDS Settlement and Reports). Debit switch settlement reports leave out any transaction type with no activity that day. Mastercard also expects switch and processor totals to differ at times (MDS Settlement and Reports).
American ExpressUnder OptBlue, Amex settles with the Merchant Services Provider, which funds the merchant on its own plan and answers settlement questions (Merchant Operating Guide). OptBlue Participants pay Amex a wholesale discount rate plus programme fees and set the merchant's price themselves (Network Assessment Fees). GNS acquirers are paid face value less a bilateral Network Rate. Clearing files are acknowledged and rejects return with up to ten reason codes (Business and Operational Policies). OptBlue settlement is wired to the Participant the business day after submission. Friday to Sunday submissions arrive as three payments on Monday (OptBlue Program Operating Regulations). Submission files sent after 11:59:59 pm Mountain time count as the next business day (OptBlue Program Operating Regulations). Amex deducts the wholesale fee, chargebacks and credits from face value. Shortfalls are taken by ACH debit, then invoiced (OptBlue Program Operating Regulations). Amex keeps wholesale and additional fees on chargebacks and credits (OptBlue Program Operating Regulations). Both sides reconcile daily from the GRRCN file, where most fees land. Where records conflict, Amex records prevail (OptBlue Program Operating Regulations). A Participant that pays the wrong merchant must correct it within ten days. Merchant funding must match the speed of other networks (OptBlue Program Operating Regulations).GRRCN Seller ID. A 20-byte field that lets an OptBlue Participant or payment aggregator reconcile fees and pricing per sub-merchant (Finance::AMEX::Transaction::GRRCN::TxnPricing). OptBlue Additional Fees table. Assessment, Acquirer Transaction, Inbound, CAPN Non-Compliance, Data Quality, data security and Excessive Chargeback fees, each described with its trigger (OptBlue Program Operating Regulations).A bank acquirer republished OptBlue pricing tiers to merchants with its own network fee added on top (Merchant Processing Services Interchange). The OptBlue Operating Regulations are marked confidential, yet an October 2024 copy is openly posted by a third party (OptBlue Program Operating Regulations). That posted copy describes each additional fee yet gives every amount only as a referral to the Participant (OptBlue Program Operating Regulations).
Discover familyDiscover collects interchange and assessments from acquirers inside daily settlement (Discover 10-K 2024). Discover relies on acquirers to give merchants one statement with Visa and Mastercard, and may withhold settlement or take collateral from riskier merchants (Discover 10-K 2024). To claim misclassification refunds, acquirers submit tab or pipe delimited data files checked with a Data Validation Tool (Additional information for Merchant).DGN service centre acquirer interchange page. The US table opens only with a verification code the acquirer issues and is marked confidential. Canada's schedule and network fees are public (Discover Acquirer Interchange · U.S. Acquirer Interchange Pricing · Standard Acquirer Rates).From 2007 to at least 2023 acquirers and merchants paid commercial interchange on consumer cards without being told. About five million cards were affected (Order to Cease). The network had no classification controls, and misclassification is defined by Discover's own records, which acquirers could not see (Order to Cease · Discover Card Merchant Class). Refunds were hard to compute because agreements, network terms and historical data varied. Allocation notices are expected only in late 2026 (Discover 10-K 2024 · Discover Card Merchant Class). Adyen's public price list charges a blended rate for Discover and Diners, against interchange plus a margin for Visa and Mastercard (Pricing for supported payment).
Cross-networkThe UK ITC Direction requires Mastercard and Visa to let acquirers see how each fee is triggered, reconcile invoices and allocate fees to UK transactions. Substantive duties apply from end of July 2027 (Specific Direction 22 · PS26/1 Market review). The August 2026 extension defers fee logic to July 2029 for fees earning £850,000 or less a year, but schemes must supply it free on request meanwhile (PS26/1 extension). Acquirers told the UK regulator they would pass most scheme fee increases to merchants at some point, whatever the contract type (MR22/1.10 Market review).Torus and CardTraq network fee analytics. Third-party invoice analysis, merchant-level allocation and flags for new or misapplied Visa and Mastercard fees (Solutions for Merchant Acquirers · Network Fee Tracking).Acquirers with over 90% of the UK market reported difficulty understanding behavioural fees, and those with over 65% struggled to get timely answers (MR22/1.10 Market review). Acquirers said they buy optional reporting to understand fees, and some said issues took months to resolve (Market review of card). Teya said scheme billing lines can hold several hundred events, each taking hours to trace (Stakeholder submissions to MR22/1.6). One firm keeps an invoice review team that found several million pounds of incorrect scheme charges in a year (PS26/1 Market review). Australian providers said schemes charge for the reports needed to reconcile fees, and some absorb small billing errors because chasing them costs more (Review of Merchant Card · Scheme Fees, Review). Most RBA submissions said confidentiality terms stop participants comparing prices or understanding their own bills (Review of Retail Payments). Acquirers staff this work. Shift4 and Stripe advertise analyst roles to reconcile scheme invoices and model new network fees (Revenue Operations, Sr Associate · Data Analyst, Payments, job).

Best pattern. The UK ITC standards set the bar. Each fee gets a unique billing identifier and free fee logic kept 12 months, with six months' notice and an impact model on request (Specific Direction 22). Discover today. Discover's US acquirer rates sit behind an acquirer-issued code while Canada's are public. The Fed now requires controls that classify and assess interchange for each acquirer and merchant (U.S. Acquirer Interchange Pricing · Standard Acquirer Rates · Order to Cease).

NetworkHow it worksTools and screensFriction
VisaVisa behavioural fees reach merchants as pass-throughs under processor descriptors, such as Misuse of Authorization, Zero Floor Limit and the Transaction Integrity Fee (Pass Through Fee Schedule). Visa replaced Level 2 and 3 with CEDP in October 2025. Only businesses Visa verifies for data quality get Product 3 rates at capture (Understand the Visa Commercial).TSYS e-Connections exception reports. Mis-Qual, Dis-Qual and Non-Qual qualification exception reports in the Portfolio Reporting module (Settlement Operations Support Self-Service).Stripe's CEDP reports carry data from two months earlier (Understand the Visa Commercial). Finix warns that poor CEDP data can downgrade past transactions, and a fee analytics firm saw merchants lose qualification where their acquirer had not finished certification (Visa’s Level 2 · Visa CEDP).
MastercardMastercard bills acquirers, so payfacs and ISOs see scheme fees only as their acquirer passes them on (MR22/1.10 Market review · Market review of card).Third-party billing monitors. Platforms that track Mastercard billing lines, bulletins and penalties for issuers and acquirers (Card Network Billing).Acquirer misreadings of Mastercard fee triggers have over and underbilled merchants (MR22/1.10 Market review).
American ExpressPayfacs under $250 million a year in Amex volume register through a certified OptBlue Participant and get single-source statement, servicing and settlement (Payments Facilitator Acceptance). Reconciliation records carry a Seller ID so a payment aggregator can match fees and pricing to each sub-merchant (Finance::AMEX::Transaction::GRRCN::TxnPricing). Processor guides price OptBlue charges by MCC industry and ticket size, with three levels per industry and dearer levels for keyed or non-US cards (American Express OptBlue Pricing · American Express OptBlue Pricing). The Amex network fee on OptBlue settled sales rose from 0.15% in First Data's 2018 guide to 0.165% in Fiserv's Fall 2025 guide (American Express OptBlue Pricing · American Express OptBlue Pricing). Participants must give merchants statements whose pricing disclosures are clear and easy to understand (OptBlue Program Operating Regulations).None found in publicAn OptBlue merchant bears the loss if its provider misprograms the POS and settlement goes to the wrong party (Merchant Operating Guide). Fiserv's Fall 2025 guide calls the Amex rates interchange, although the OptBlue regulations say the wholesale fee is not interchange (American Express OptBlue Pricing · OptBlue Program Operating Regulations). Processor guides warn that terminals or software sending data wrongly can cost merchants the best pricing level (American Express OptBlue Pricing).
Discover familyDiscover reaches payfac and ISO merchants through acquirer pricing, which a large acquirer sets as a blended rate for Discover (Pricing for supported payment · Discover 10-K 2024).None found in publicA merchant services firm says merchants on flat or tiered plans cannot see migrated Discover debit rates on their statements (Capital One’s Discover Merger).
Cross-networkUnder the sponsor model, network standards bar processors such as Global Payments from performing funds settlement or touching merchant settlement funds (Global Payments 10-K 2025 · Payment Facilitator vs ISO.). A payfac settles funds daily to each sub-merchant, and a sponsor bank says funding reconciliation is more burdensome in that model (PayFac vs. ISO · PayFac vs ISO). Stripe charges network costs to a platform and recovers them from each connected account within hours (Network cost passthrough).Stripe IC+ plan-level report for connected accounts. Interchange plan names per account, with scheme fees shown as one aggregated total per month (Network cost passthrough).UK acquirers could not identify which merchants triggered behavioural fees, so the cost spreads across all their merchants (Market review of card · MR22/1.10 Market review).

Best pattern. Amex's Seller ID in reconciliation records lets an aggregator match each fee to the sub-merchant that caused it, which UK acquirers said they cannot do for Visa and Mastercard (Finance::AMEX::Transaction::GRRCN::TxnPricing · Market review of card). Discover today. The study found no public Discover money material for payfacs or ISOs. They see Discover through acquirer pricing, often blended, where migrated debit rates are invisible on flat plans (Pricing for supported payment · Capital One’s Discover Merger).

ATM operators (independent deployers and ISOs, large deployers, bank and credit union fleets)

NetworkHow it worksTools and screensFriction
VisaVisa ATM interchange flows from issuer to ATM acquirer, in four US withdrawal levels from 30 to 60 cents. Declines and balance inquiries also pay (Visa USA Interchange Reimbursement · Visa USA Interchange Reimbursement). Cardtronics alleges the network deducts its acquirer fee from issuer-paid interchange, and that Visa raised that fee from 6 to 16 cents in 2012 (Cardtronics USA v. Visa). ATM acquirers must ensure their ATM operators and agents keep per-terminal records, including electronic journals, for Visa on request, and can be dropped from the tier II level (Visa Core Rules). Visa rule changes reach operators through processors. CDS relayed October 2025 rules requiring per-terminal agreements and on-demand journal data, on pain of suspension and fines (Visa Rules Update Affecting). Visa's guide shows single message acquirers how to reconcile the SMS601C acquirer detail report to VSS-900-S, field by field (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS) · VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). SMS settlement cuts off at 8 pm Pacific for Interlink and 10 pm Pacific for Visa and Plus. Every SMS report header shows the online settlement date (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)). Through the day the system keeps running totals of counts and amounts every 30 minutes. It stores them as 0520 advices for the processor to recover (VisaNet Settlement Service (VSS)).None found in publicNetwork fees on surcharged withdrawals and EMV fallback fees reach operators only if their processor passes them through (How to Read).
MastercardUS Mastercard ATM interchange pays USD 0.35 for Tier 1 issuers, USD 0.45 for Tier 2 and USD 0.50 base per withdrawal (Mastercard 2026-2027 U.S. Region · Mastercard 2026-2027 U.S. Region). Tiers are reset every quarter from the issuer's settled ATM volume (Mastercard 2026-2027 U.S. Region). In Europe a late presentment fee applies to ATM first presentments older than 45 days (Global Clearing Management System). On Mastercard's debit switch, processors settle with terminal owners themselves. The switch settles only with each processor, per the 2006 manual (MDS Settlement and Reports). Debit switch transactions received after day end settle on the next business day (MDS Settlement and Reports). In 2006 the debit switch day ended at 07:00 New York time for Debit Mastercard and 15:00 for Maestro and Cirrus (MDS Settlement and Reports).SWCHD53 Exception Audit and SWCHD55 Detailed Suspect Items. Every reversal, chargeback and representment settled that day, and transactions that failed, for representment research and chargeback monitoring (MDS Settlement and Reports).When an issuer range moves from Cirrus to Visa and Plus, earlier transactions must still clear through Mastercard (Global Clearing Management System). The exception audit report came only as a bulk file. It was the one debit switch report missing from eService (MDS Settlement and Reports). In 2006 Mastercard retired two transaction audit reports and pointed members to the raw 250-byte batch data file instead (MDS Settlement and Reports).
Discover familyPULSE Gateway settles activity for many ATM and POS networks through one system on one cutoff, with exception items for all of them in PULSE PIX2 (PULSE Gateway Services · Debit Processing and Gateways). For some international ATM acquirers Discover carries the risk that an issuer fails to settle (Discover 10-K 2024). On FIS surcharge reports for bank fleets, Discover appears as its own network line beside STAR, NYCE, Cirrus and Plus (Daily and Monthly Reports).PULSE Debit Dashboard, PULSE ATM module. Product view for ATM activity inside the dashboard (PULSE Debit Dashboard User).PULSE markets competitive ATM interchange and fees but publishes no amounts (ATM Acquirers · PULSE ATM Network).
Cross-networkAn independent operator's processor statement carries three streams. Vault cash and surcharge settle by ACH the next banking day, and interchange arrives monthly (ATM Processing · How to Read · ATM 101). Operators reconcile per terminal, matching withdrawals, surcharge and settlement dates to deposits and allowing for funds in transit (How to Read). Revenue splits are fixed before a terminal goes live, through an installation worksheet, ACH authorisations and a voided cheque (ATM 101). Networks set both the interchange issuers pay and the amount paid to a deployer (NCR Atleos 10-K 2025). A credit union ATM settlement analyst balances ATM general ledgers daily, and bank fleets balance from a terminal transaction detail report (ATM Settlement and Claims · Daily and Monthly Reports).CDS ATM Management Platform. Terminal setup, status alerts, cash forecasting, automated adjustment filing and online transaction detail for ISOs (ATM Processing Solutions). Switch Commerce Terminal Management System. Terminal data, settlement distribution, automated reports and vault cash forecasting, mirrored in a mobile app (ATM Processing). FIS EFSURNET-R01 surcharge report. Monthly surcharge income by terminal and network for bank-owned fleets (Daily and Monthly Reports).Operator statements stack portal, statement, per-transaction and network pass-through fees, and sellers advise buyers to demand a sample statement (ATM Processing Fees Explained). A software vendor says many operators run reconciliation in separate systems with spreadsheets filling the gaps (What's an ATM's total). NCR Atleos treats errors in merchant settlement or vault cash reconciliation as a risk to customer relationships (NCR Atleos 10-K 2025). A processor tells operators network penalties can reach $50,000 per event per device (Network rules regarding cashless).
InteracInterac publishes its switch fees with dated future changes and ABM interchange of $0.75, and says the switch fee is its only charge on cash withdrawals (Understanding Fees).None found in publicNone found in public
LinkLINK in the UK takes no share of interchange and pays it through a monthly settlement process (NoteMachine UK Limited v).None found in publicNone found in public

Best pattern. Interac publishes its ATM switch fee, ABM interchange and dated future changes on one public page, so an operator can check its statement against the network (Understanding Fees). Discover today. PULSE offers single-point settlement and exception handling across gateway networks, yet publishes no ATM interchange amounts for operators to check against (PULSE Gateway Services · Debit Processing and Gateways · ATM Acquirers).

It declares a status incident if a day is still incomplete at end of day (Settlement API · Settlement API). Discover today.
